title: Senior Engineering Manager - Streaming
description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.
 
  
 


**Roku is changing how the world watches TV** 

 Roku is the \#1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.
 



 From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable \- and valued \- contribution. We're a fast\-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.
 



  
 


 About the role
 
 Roku pioneered TV streaming and continues to innovate and lead the industry. The Roku Channel has us well\-positioned to help shape the future of streaming. Continued success relies on investing in the Roku Cloud TV Platform so we deliver high quality streaming TV experience at a global scale.
 



 You will be part of the Roku Video Platform Engineering team that is building the next generation video services for the Roku Cloud TV Platform. In this role you will work on key video services projects around video ingestion, encoding, VoD/live\-linear, Ads Insertion services, DRM and Video QoS, with the goal of delivering best\-in\-class streaming TV experience across all of Roku devices. The projects that you will work on will impact millions of Roku users around the world. All along, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with key product engineering stakeholders across Roku engineering teams, and lead the design of our video services platform.
 



 The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong technical leadership, bring endless curiosity and can pair a global mindset with locally relevant execution. You should be a gritty problem solver and self\-starter who can drive programs with the product and commercial teams within Roku and across external strategic partner organizations. The successful candidate will display a balance of hard and soft skills, including the ability to respond quickly to changing business needs.
   

  




 How will I use AI at Roku?
 
 At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. 
 



 We value
 
 your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.
 



  
 


 What you’ll be doing
 * You will lead a team of engineers towards building high availability cloud hosted video platform that powers key elements of the Roku streaming platform.
* Spearhead efforts towards building scalable and robust video processing pipelines, improve video workflows including transcoding, packaging, publishing and ads insertion
* Provide technical and organizational leadership in executing our video services initiatives including to deliver high quality, low latency, delightful streaming experiences, fine tune quality of experience, investigate and remediate potential streaming quality of service problems
* Key technical contributor to the design and implementation of core software backend components of video services platform
* Evaluate architectural tradeoffs for performance and security for high performance, and high concurrency video infrastructure applications
* Drive relentless focus on innovation, increasing user delight and improving the quality of user experience, reliability, stability, security and quality of the apps. Contribute towards enhancing a culture of engineering and operational excellence.
* Collaborate across teams – Work with product, UX, and engineering teams to define scope and make product decisions, Influence cross\-team alignment and provide thought leadership across the organization
* Attract top engineers in the industry, mentor and guide overall professional development of the team


 We’re excited if you have
 * 5\+ years proven track record in hiring, building and leading high\-caliber product engineering teams
* 8\+ years of software development experience with deep technical knowledge and expertise in building high availability, large\-scale distributed systems and services
* Experience with modern cloud\-based video processing platforms, e.g. AWS Elemental or Azure Media Services
* Video Streaming domain knowledge, experience with media formats, e.g. DASH, HLS, CMAF, MPEG\-4, etc., and DRM technologies such as Widevine and Fairplay
* Experience with Ad insertion technologies and frameworks is a big plus!
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to build strong relationships with stakeholders, teams, and senior leaders across the organization. Ability to operate at both hands\-on technical depth and strategic leadership level
* Strong leadership, collaboration and communication skills in working with cross\-functional teams across the organization, and delivering on big and ambitious goals
* Experience in Connected TV environments – with understanding of the unique technical constraints and requirements of this space is a big plus.
* Demonstrable GenAI fluency and in actively using Agentic AI engineering tools to accelerate product development
* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, plus 10\+ years of experience or equivalent; Master's degree preferred.



  
 


  
 **What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?**

 Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.
 



  
 


**What are some of the benefits?** 

 Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.
 



  
 


**Accommodations** 

 Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.
 



  
 


**What should I know about Roku's culture?** 

 Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast\-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV.
 



 We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem\-solvers, which itself is a two\-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002\.
 



 To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.
 



 By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

description:

This is a high\-impact leadership role for a Transition Managerwho is ready to shape the future of application transitions — combining deep delivery expertise with AI\-powered innovation to redefine how complex global IT services are handed over, stabilized, and scaled.


We are looking for a seasoned **Application Transition Manager** to lead end\-to\-end planning, solutioning, and execution of complex, multi\-service managed services, application development, and support/maintenance transitions. This role sits at the intersection of delivery leadership, AI\-powered modernization, and enterprise\-scale program governance.


The ideal candidate brings deep hands\-on experience in transitioning large application development/support portfolios — including custom\-built, packaged, and cloud\-native applications — and is fluent in harnessing AI tools, automation, and intelligent accelerators to compress timelines, reduce risk, and elevate transition quality.


You will operate as the single accountable owner across pre\-sales solutioning and live execution, partnering closely with the client, delivery towers, and incumbent vendors to deliver a seamless transition to steady\-state operations.

**Responsibilities**

* Independently design and own transition solutions for complex outsourcing pursuits across multi\-vendor, multi\-geo, multi\-stack, multi\-service (Apps, Infra, Security, Automation, Cloud) environments
* Define transition strategy, milestone frameworks, resource models, and success KPIs for RFP/RFI/SOW responses and contract negotiations
* Defend the proposed transition solutions and execution approaches to senior Client stakeholders / C\-suite audiences (Orals)
* Design AI\-powered transition solutions using GenAI\-based knowledge extraction, automated documentation generation, and intelligent codebase discovery to accelerate solutioning timelines
* Leverage AI estimating models and effort prediction tools to build data\-driven transition business cases and risk\-adjusted transition plans during pre\-sales
* Lead transitions of 100\+ applications spanning custom development, microservices, APIs, data platforms, ERP/CRM systems, and cloud\-native workloads

Manage all transition phases: Knowledge Acquisition Shadow Reverse Shadow Parallel Run Stabilization (Hypercare)* BAU Handover
* Oversee structured code and architecture discovery activities — codebase walkthroughs, dependency mapping, tech\-debt assessment, and environment cataloging
* Ensure delivery of all transition artifacts: SOPs, Runbooks, Application Passports, Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), RACI matrices, and operational documentation
* Manage Knowledge Acquisition sessions across development teams (onshore/offshore), ensuring structured capture of tribal knowledge, design rationale, and undocumented dependencies
* Deploy AI\-based code analysis tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, CodeScene, SonarQube AI) to accelerate codebase understanding, surface tech debt, and auto\-generate inline documentation during Knowledge Acquisition
* Use GenAI\-powered documentation tools to auto\-draft SOPs, Runbooks, and Application Passports from discovery sessions, reducing documentation effort by up to 40%
* Apply AI\-driven dependency mapping tools to visualize application interdependencies, integration touchpoints, and data flows across complex portfolios
* Establish and chair Transition Governance Forums — weekly/bi\-weekly SteerCos, RAID reviews, milestone checkpoint meetings, and executive reporting cadences
* Maintain a real\-time Transition Dashboard tracking milestones, knowledge transfer completion, risk status, team readiness scores, and go\-live criteria
* Drive RAID log management (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) and proactively resolve blockers impacting transition timelines
* Manage 50\+ active stakeholders — client executives, product owners, architects, vendor leads, and delivery managers — across multiple geographies
* Use AI\-powered project analytics tools and NLP\-based status reporting to auto\-generate executive dashboards and transition health summaries
* Define and execute Go\-Live Readiness Criteria encompassing access provisioning, monitoring setup, SLA framework validation, on\-call rota, and escalation paths
* Lead structured Hypercare operations post\-go\-live: stabilization sprints, defect triage, performance baselining, and SLA attainment tracking
* Ensure tooling readiness: ITSM (ServiceNow), observability stack (Dynatrace, Splunk, Datadog), CMDB accuracy, and alerting configuration
* Integrate AIOps capabilities (anomaly detection, predictive alerting) during Hypercare to proactively surface risks before they escalate to incidents

Role Purpose
  
  

We are looking for a business\-oriented Enterprise Architect to lead technology strategy and architecture workstreams across complex digital transformation engagements.The Enterprise Architect will work with senior business and technology stakeholders to translate enterprise strategy, business capabilities, value streams and future\-state processes into integrated application, data, integration, infrastructure and security architectures. The role will typically operate during Phase 0, discovery, assessment and transformation\-planning engagements, helping customers establish the case for change, evaluate strategic platform options and define an actionable transformation roadmap.The successful candidate will combine architecture depth with strong consulting, facilitation and commercial skills. The role requires the ability to move from current\-state diagnosis to target architecture, prioritized initiatives, business\-case inputs and implementation mobilization.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Lead enterprise architecture and technology strategy workstreams across digital and business transformation engagements.
  
Establish pragmatic architecture methods, principles, standards, viewpoints and decision criteria.
  
Assess current business capabilities, processes, applications, data, integrations, infrastructure, cloud services, security controls and technology risks.
  
Develop business capability maps, value\-stream architectures and traceability between business requirements, processes, applications and data.
  
Define integrated target architectures covering business, application, data, integration, infrastructure, cloud and cybersecurity domains.
  
Translate future\-state processes and operating\-model requirements into technology capabilities, solution options and architecture decisions.
  
Lead digital\-core, ERP, CRM, supply chain, manufacturing, asset\-management, data\-platform and enterprise\-application strategy assessments.
  
Evaluate strategic platforms and vendors based on business fit, architecture fit, scalability, integration, data, security, cost, implementation risk and organizational readiness.
  
Conduct application technical\-health, strategic\-fit and portfolio\-rationalization assessments using frameworks such as TIME or equivalent.
  
Convert architecture gaps and recommendations into prioritized transformation initiatives and implementation work packages.
  
Develop high\-level project charters covering scope, outcomes, capabilities, architecture, dependencies, risks, effort and success measures.
  
Create phased technology roadmaps aligned with business value, process transformation, data foundations, change readiness and investment capacity.
  
Provide technology cost, benefit, dependency and risk inputs to business cases and value\-realization plans.
  
Define enterprise architecture, application, integration and data\-governance models, including decision rights and architecture\-assurance processes.
  
Facilitate workshops and present architecture options, trade\-offs and recommendations to executive and senior\-management stakeholders.
  
Provide technical direction and quality assurance to domain architects, solution architects, business analysts and platform specialists.
  
Support proposals, solution shaping, estimation, presales and development of architecture methods and reusable consulting assets.
  
  

Required Experience and Skills
  
  

8\+ or more years of experience across enterprise architecture, technology strategy, solution architecture or digital transformation.
  
Proven experience leading Phase 0, discovery, assessment, technology strategy, roadmap or pre\-implementation advisory engagements.
  
Strong understanding of business capabilities, value streams, end\-to\-end processes and Target Operating Model design.
  
Experience developing current\-state, target\-state and transition architectures.
  
Ability to integrate business, application, data, integration, infrastructure, cloud and security perspectives.
  
Experience with ERP, digital\-core or enterprise\-platform strategy involving solutions such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Fusion or comparable platforms.
  
Experience assessing and rationalizing complex application portfolios.
  
Experience defining strategic initiatives, project charters, transition architectures and multi\-year transformation roadmaps.
  
Understanding of API, integration\-platform, event\-driven, data\-platform, analytics, master\-data and cloud\-architecture concepts.
  
Experience in one or more complex domains, such as process manufacturing, industrial products, chemicals, energy, utilities, life sciences, consumer products, logistics or asset\-intensive industries.
  
Strong executive communication, consulting, workshop\-facilitation and stakeholder\-management skills.
  
Ability to explain complex architecture decisions as clear business choices, implications and recommendations.
  
Commercial awareness and experience supporting proposals, estimates, business cases or vendor evaluations.
  
  

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business or a related discipline.
  
Postgraduate qualification in business, strategy, technology or management is advantageous.
  
TOGAF, ArchiMate, cloud, data, Microsoft, SAP, Oracle or comparable architecture certification is desirable.
  
Familiarity with enterprise architecture tools such as LeanIX, Ardoq, Bizzdesign, Orbus, MEGA or Sparx Enterprise Architect.
  
Experience with process\-manufacturing concepts such as batch genealogy, quality management, asset traceability and supply\-chain planning is advantageous.
  
Experience working across multiple countries, business units or acquisition\-led technology landscapes is preferred.

**Experience:** 10\+ Years

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced **BIM Coordinator** with 10\+ years of experience in the construction/engineering industry to lead and manage multidisciplinary BIM coordination activities. The candidate will be responsible for coordinating **Architectural, Civil, Structural and MEP models**, identifying and resolving clashes, reviewing construction drawings and ensuring accurate and coordinated BIM deliverables throughout the project lifecycle.

The ideal candidate should be capable of **independently leading BIM coordination**, coordinating with internal departments, consultants, contractors and project/site teams, and driving projects from design coordination through construction and as\-built stages.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage **multidisciplinary BIM coordination** between Architectural, Civil, Structural, MEP, QS and Project teams.
* Review and coordinate BIM models and construction drawings to ensure **design accuracy, constructability and coordination**.
* Perform **clash detection, clash analysis and resolution** using Navisworks Manage and coordinate with respective discipline teams for timely closure.
* Manage and review BIM models up to **LOD 500**, including construction\-stage and as\-built requirements.
* Develop, implement and maintain **BIM Execution Plans, BIM standards, modelling procedures and QA/QC workflows**.
* Review model quality, naming conventions, model revisions, drawing outputs and BIM documentation.
* Coordinate with **Architects, Structural Engineers, MEP Engineers, QS, Project Managers, Contractors and Site Engineers** to resolve design and construction\-related coordination issues.
* Conduct and lead **BIM coordination meetings**, prepare clash/coordination reports and monitor closure of actions.
* Review shop drawings, coordinated drawings, model outputs and construction documentation for compliance with project requirements.
* Ensure proper model federation, version control, data management and coordination workflows.
* Support preparation and validation of **LOD 400/500 deliverables and as\-built BIM models**.
* Guide and mentor BIM Engineers/Modelers and ensure timely delivery of assigned BIM activities.
* Identify design conflicts at an early stage and proactively coordinate with relevant departments to minimize rework and site issues.
* Maintain effective communication between **design, engineering, BIM and construction teams** throughout the project lifecycle.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Autodesk Revit
* Navisworks
* AutoCAD
* BIM 360 / Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC)

**Candidate Profile**

* **10\+ years of overall experience** in construction, engineering consultancy or BIM coordination.
* Strong hands\-on experience in **BIM coordination and multidisciplinary construction projects**.
* Proven experience in a **Lead BIM Coordinator / BIM Lead / Senior BIM Coordinator** role.
* Strong practical knowledge of **LOD 300, LOD 400 and LOD 500** workflows.
* Excellent understanding of **Architectural, Civil, Structural and MEP drawings** and construction methodology.
* Strong experience in **clash detection, coordination and issue resolution**.
* Should be capable of independently leading BIM activities and coordinating multiple teams.
* Excellent communication, leadership, coordination and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience in large\-scale residential, commercial, industrial or infrastructure projects will be preferred.
* Knowledge of **ISO 19650 / BIM standards and information management** will be an added advantage.

Education

**B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering / B.Arch** 

What We Are Looking For

A **hands\-on BIM leader**, not just a modeller — someone who can understand drawings and construction requirements, lead multidisciplinary coordination, and ensure the project is delivered with **accurate, coordinated and construction\-ready BIM models**.

title: Principal System Architecture (Digital AdTech)
description:
***Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.***








**Who We Are…**





 When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the
 *storytellers* 
 bringing our characters to life, the
 *creators* 
 bringing them to your living rooms and the
 *dreamers* 
 creating what’s next…
 









 From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.
 








 Your New Role: The Senior Principal, System Architecture reports to the VP Engineering, Converged AdTech \& Linear Systems and leads the architecture for WBD’s most critical advertising technology platforms. This role owns and drives the systems automation architecture of core adtech platforms to improve scalability, reliability, performance, and cost efficiency across the ecosystem. This role is accountable for the architecture, scalability, and operational excellence of systems spanning converged planning, linear and digital advertising, scheduling, and affiliate distribution. By architecting the platform rationalization, cloud migration, and next\-generation AI/ML\-enabled capabilities, the Principal ensures WBD’s ad\-tech stack is positioned to maximize monetization, enable automation, and deliver premium advertising experiences across all platforms.
 







 Your Role Accountabilities:
 



 AI‑Driven \& Agentic Systems Automation
 



 Define and drive the long\-term architecture for AI\-powered and agentic systems across large\-scale AdTech platforms. • Architect autonomous and human\-in\-the\-loop systems for deployment orchestration, infrastructure lifecycle, and incident response • Establish guardrails for safe, observable, and governed AI adoption (reliability, explainability, failure handling) • Integrate AI capabilities into core platform layers (decisioning, optimization, experimentation, operations) • Drive standardization of agentic workflows across engineering and operations Expectation: redefines how systems are built and operated using AI and not just adds features.
 







 Platform Architecture \& System Engineering
 



 Own the design and evolution of foundational platforms with strong system engineering principles. • Define architecture for core platforms (AdOps automation, optimization, identity, data, measurement, activation) with clear boundaries and contracts • Apply system engineering rigor across reliability, scalability, fault isolation, and performance under extreme load • Establish patterns for multi\-region, high\-availability, and disaster\-resilient systems • Drive platform standardization to reduce fragmentation and improve developer velocity Expectation: builds platforms that are resilient, composable, and operable at scale.
 







 Enterprise System Evolution \& Convergence Lead transformation of fragmented systems into a cohesive, converged AdTech ecosystem (linear \+ digital).
 



 • Identify systemic bottlenecks across latency, data consistency, and cross platform dependencies
 



 • Drive simplification of system topology and elimination of redundant architectures
 



 • Lead large\-scale modernization (monolith → services, siloed systems → shared platforms)
 



 • Ensure seamless interoperability across legacy and next\-gen systems Expectation: reduces long\-term complexity while enabling scale and agility. Technology Strategy \& Architectural Leadership Shape the long\-term technology direction and elevate architectural capability across the organization.
 



 • Evaluate emerging technologies (streaming, distributed systems, AI infra, Agentic AI, privacy tech) for strategic adoption • Mentor Principal engineers and architects on system design and trade offs • Establish architectural governance and decision frameworks Expectation: builds both systems and the people who design them.
 



 Technical Authority \& Execution Influence
 



 Act as the highest\-level technical authority across critical initiatives. • Review and approve architecture for high\-impact, high\-risk systems • Influence execution across orgs without direct authority • Intervene in complex programs to de\-risk delivery and ensure architectural integrity • Align engineering, product, and business stakeholders on critical trade offs Expectation: drives decisions that materially impact system and business outcomes
 



 Qualifications \& Experience
 



 • Systems Architecture Leadership: 15\+ years of experience architecting and scaling enterprise\-grade data platforms, with a proven track record in large scale ingestion, transformation, and activation pipelines.
 



 • Automation Expertise: Experience automating high‑availability, high‑throughput production environments, leveraging AI and agentic architectures.
 



 • Distributed Data Expertise: Advanced knowledge of open data Lakehouse formats (Iceberg, Delta, Hudi), distributed compute frameworks (Spark, Flink, Presto), and streaming technologies (Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub).
 



 • Cloud \& Modern Architecture: Hands\-on expertise in cloud\-native data design (AWS, GCP, Azure), microservices, APIs, and serverless architectures; demonstrated success in modernizing legacy platforms into modular, cost efficient systems.
 



 • Identity \& Audience Platforms: Familiarity with identity resolution, audience graphs, and cross\-platform measurement systems in media, advertising, or adjacent high\-scale transaction domains.
 



 • Engineering Excellence: Deep knowledge of data engineering best practices, CI/CD automation, observability, data lineage, and governance frameworks that ensure reliability and compliance.
 



 • Performance \& Optimization: Skilled in cost modeling, benchmarking, and optimizing large\-scale distributed systems for throughput, latency, and cost efficiency.
 



 • Industry Awareness: Strong grasp of emerging trends in ad\-tech, programmatic ecosystems, ML/AI\-driven data products, and privacy\-first architectures (GDPR, CCPA, VPPA).
 



 • Partnerships \& Ecosystem: Experienced in leading technical evaluations, vendor integrations, and collaborations with third\-party data providers, cloud platforms, and open\-source communities.
 



 • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical discipline required
 















  


**How We Get Things Done…**









 This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at
 

















 www.wbd.com/guiding\-principles/
 

















 along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.
 








**Championing Inclusion at WBD**



 Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.
 









 If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our
 
 accessibility page
 
 for instructions to submit your request.

title: EH-FY27-Consulting-S&T-Strategy-Senior Consultant-TS-SFL-AI Strategy
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**AI Strategic Architect**
 SFL Scientific, a Deloitte Business practice brings together several key capabilities to architect integrated programs that transform our clients' businesses, including Strategic Growth Transformation, Transformation Strategy \& Design, Technology Strategy \& Business Transformation, and AI \& Data Strategy.
   

  

 Professionals will serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data\-driven choices, using the latest state\-of\-the\-art technologies, to advise our clients on how to leverage AI technologies and working directly with them to design and implement novel solutions that drive value.
   

  

 We are hiring AI Strategic Architects to support and lead development, deployment, and maintenance of novel AI solutions and cloud architectures across healthcare, manufacturing, energy, retail, finance, and other sectors.
   

  

**Work you’ll do**
 As an AI Strategic Architect at SFL Scientific, a Deloitte Business, you’ll work with a cross\-functional strategy and AI team to bring solutions to life.
   

  

 We seek individuals with a strategic mindset for planning and implementing AI systems for large\-scale organizations on both on\-prem and cloud infrastructure.
   

  

 You will be responsible for designing, deploying, benchmarking, and scaling solutions from test environments to global production, impacting millions. Key tasks also include gathering and understanding business requirements, identification of performance gaps, and the design and implementation of scalable solutions in the client’s environment.
   

  

 Successful candidates will work with non\-technical stakeholders, IT teams, and existing solution teams to translate requirements into a technical design, handling both strategic design and implementation tasks, to drive value for our clients.
   

  

**Design \& Planning** 
 :
   

  

* Work directly with clients, stakeholders and user groups to understand requirements and communicate technical decisions and trade\-offs.
* Interact with client IT teams to ensure solutions are compatible with their requirements and that deployment schedules are timely, efficient and well\-coordinated between teams.
* Integrate with a broader delivery team to design technical specifications that outline the resources, functions, interfaces and architecture of a scaled solution applicable to the common hyperscalers (AWS, GSP, Azure).
* Assess small scale functional AI solutions and determine performance gaps, required enhancements and technical solutions for deploying those solutions at scale \- this spans data security, latency considerations, large concurrent workloads, performance expectations, user requirements.
* Assist in documentation required for successful product deployment, this could include sustain processes, user guides, interface schematics etc.


**Execution** 
 :
   

  

* Sprint planning and implementation of technical architectures, this would include implementing CICD pipelines, deploying cloud resources, implementing Kubernetes based deployments, networking across cloud resources, ETL pipelines.
* Design and development of web\-based UI’s.
* Implementation and testing of core application enhancements with a focus on AI workloads (ex. RAG applications, multi\-agent workloads, AI modeling enhancements).


**The Team**
 SFL Scientific, a Deloitte Business, is a data science professional services practice focused on strategy, technology, and solving business challenges with Artificial Intelligence (AI). The team has a proven track record serving large, market\-leading organizations in the private and public sectors, successfully delivering high\-quality, novel and complex projects, and offering deep domain and scientific capabilities. Made up of experienced AI strategists, data scientists, and AI engineers, they serve as trusted advisors to executives, helping them understand and evaluate new and essential areas for AI investment and identify unique opportunities to transform their businesses.
   

  

**Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant STEM Field (ex. Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics)
* 5\+ years of experience working in data science, data engineering, software engineering, and/or MLOps.
* Experience with cloud deployment (AWS, Azure, GCP), such as designing, building, and scaling using cloud tools such as AWS SageMaker or Azure ML Studio.
* 5\+ years working with core cloud application development tools \& services (ex. Kubernetes, docker, Argo CD, Jenkins, Terraform, DVC, MLFlow, Kubeflow, FastAPI, ADO).
* 3\+ years’ experience with implementing application with genAI toolsets (ex. Azure OpenAI, Bedrock, LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, OpenLLM, vLLM, NIM, NEMO, LangFuse)


**\#FY27ReferralCampaign** 
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Graduate level degree (Masters/PhD) or Undergraduate level degree (B.Tech) in relevant STEM field (Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering etc.) from premier colleges such as IIT, BITS, NIT, and IISC
* 3\+ years of experience in AI/ML algorithm development workflow and data analysis in the major data modalities from NLP, time\-series analysis, computer vision, to graph models with an emphasis on generative AI and Large Language Models.
* 3\+ years of experience in core programming languages and data science packages (Python, Keras, Tensorflow, PyTorch, Pandas, Scikit\-learn, etc.)
* Experience in designing robust software engineering solutions.
* Demonstrated excellence in verbal and written communication skills and experience in a client\-facing or team management role.
* Highly proficient written and verbal skills to support briefings, proposals, technical sprint plans, solution reports, progress updates, and executive presentations.
* 2\+ years’ experience designing and developing web\-based UI’s using React.
* 2\+ years’ experience with data tools and databases (ex. MongoDB, RDS) and vector databases (ex. Milvus, ChromaDB, ElasticSearch, Pinecone).
* 2\+ years’ experience with scripting languages with a heavy emphasis on python.
* Familiarity with Linux operating systems and bash scripting.
* Familiarity with monitoring, alert tools and dashboards (ex. Grafana, Prometheus, Tableau, PowerBI)


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
   

  

**Recruiting tips**

description:
**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**
**Job Title:** 
 R\&D Member of Technical Staff II, Cloud Operations \& Infrastructure
   

  

**Location:** 
 Hyderabad/Bangalore
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
   

  

**Work Mode** 
 : Hybrid work arrangement
   

  

***At AVEVA, we’re all about limitless possibilities. Are you?***
 As part of the Research and Development function, the global Cloud Operations \& Infrastructure team combines software development and cloud operations to provide continuous integration and delivery of cloud\-enabled products and solutions, along with continuous monitoring to ensure various cloud\-specific customer requirements/SLAs are met.
   

  

 As a Cloud Operations Engineer you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and implementing advanced cloud\-based applications and services. Your work will focus on pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in cloud computing, exploring new technologies, and developing innovative solutions that align with the company’s strategic goals.
   

  

 Working closely with your development and portfolio colleagues, together you will bring new solutions to the cloud following a standard framework to ensure they are operationally secure, stable and scalable.
   

  

 The global, 24x7 nature of the team means there may be a requirement for occasional work outside of the standard day and to be on call as part of a shared team rota.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Work on modern approaches to software development including the ability to develop microservices and leverage serverless functions.
* Work with development teams to advise and contribute to improvements to operational stability, security, cost management and reporting requirements for our cloud solutions.
* Continually develop and improve DevOps processes, adding value through optimization, automation, and effective reporting.
* Provide timely and effective response to incidents to minimize the impact on our customers and keep colleagues updated as required.

**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Job Description – AI and Hybrid Infrastructure Strategy (Sr. Consultant)** 
**At Deloitte Strategy \& Transactions (S\&T), we don’t just advise — we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth** 
**Within S\&T, the AI and Hybrid Infrastructure strategy capability plays a critical role in shaping how organizations modernize their core technology foundations to enable digital, cloud, and AI\-led transformation. As a Strategy professional in this space, you will help clients define their enterprise\-wide AI and hybrid infrastructure strategy, help them make sense of their AI consumption economics, identify value creation and cost optimization opportunities, and design future\-ready operating models that bridge business ambition with technical reality.** 
**But we don’t stop at client impact, we are equally passionate about investing in our people. You’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands\-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. We design differentiated career paths that empower our talent to thrive.** 
**If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real\-world impact, and where your growth matters as much as your clients’, AI and Hybrid Infrastructure Strategy is your next move.**
**The Team**
 The AI and Hybrid Infrastructure team sits at the core of Deloitte’s technology\-enabled transformation agenda. We advise clients on where and how to modernize their infrastructure landscape — spanning data centers, hybrid and multi\-cloud platforms, networks, and AI\-enabled infrastructure — to support business growth, resilience, and innovation.
   

  

 Our work is strategy\-led and outcome\-oriented, focused on helping executives make clear, data\-driven decisions on topics such as:
   

  

* AI Infrastructure strategy
* AI Economics / Tokenomics strategy
* Hybrid Cloud strategy
* Enterprise Infrastructure and platform enablement
* Legacy modernization and technical debt reduction
* Cost optimization, resilience, and scalability
* Technology operating model and governance design
* AI / Hybrid Cloud sourcing strategies


 Strategy professionals in this team act as trusted advisors to CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and business leaders, translating complex business problems into actionable technology choices. We are looking for Consultants and Senior Consultants who combine strong analytical thinking with a solid understanding of modern infrastructure and AI ecosystems.
   

  

**Work You Will Do**
 As part of the AI and Hybrid Infrastructure Strategy team, you will work with clients to shape and execute their AI infrastructure and platform strategies across hybrid environments (Cloud. On\-premise, Edge) ensuring alignment with broader business and digital transformation goals.
   

  

 Your responsibilities will include supporting enterprise infrastructure and AI platform strategies (including hybrid and multi\-cloud adoption roadmaps, investment prioritization, and value realization cases), advising clients on high\-level AI\-ready infrastructure architectures, designing target\-state technology operating models, compute and token consumption strategies, including trade\-offs between cost, performance, scalability and conducting strategic assessment and diagnostics across infrastructure, AI platforms and MLOps. This role provides exposure to complex, high\-visibility transformation programs and enables you to build deep expertise at the intersection of strategy, AI, and enterprise infrastructure in a client\-facing consulting environment.
   

  

**Required Experience And Skills**
* Ability to translate complex infrastructure and AI architecture concepts into clear business value narratives for executive and non\-technical stakeholders
* Strong understanding of how infrastructure, cloud, data and AI investments drive growth, cost efficiency, risk reduction, and operational resilience

* Infrastructure, Cloud and AI domain knowledge:
* Foundational understanding of enterprise infrastructure concepts, including compute, storage, networking, and hybrid / multi\-cloud architectures

* Familiarity with AI/ML workloads, platforms, frameworks, ecosystems (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, NVIDIA AI platforms) and their infrastructure implications
* Understanding of key compliance, security, and regulatory standards relevant to Infrastructure and AI environments (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST CSF)
* Architecture \& Transformation Experience: Candidates are required to have at least one full project experience in either one or more of the following areas:
* AI or cloud infrastructure strategy, architecture, or large\-scale transformation initiatives
* Design or assessment of AI/ML platforms, MLOps workflows, or AI\-ready infrastructure environments
* Infrastructure modernization, cost optimization, or operating model transformation programs
* AI Economics and optimization
* Exposure to integrating compute, networking, and storage capabilities to support scalable AI or cloud workloads, with an emphasis on architectural decision\-making rather than hands\-on operations
* Experience supporting ecosystem\-driven solutions and working with technology partners to shape solution options and recommendations
* Ability to support benchmarking, performance assessments, and business case development to inform infrastructure and AI investment decisions
* Experience defining target operating models (TOMs), roadmaps, governance frameworks, and process designs
* Exposure to security, governance, and compliance considerations across infrastructure and AI stacks
* Interest in contributing to internal knowledge development, POVs, or client thought leadership as part of broader practice growth
* Exposure to working with non\-India Geographies (preferably the US) and / or interacting with Global stakeholders


**Core Consulting Skills**
* Clear and concise communication \- conduct client interviews, participate in workshops/trainings and present recommendations
* Good client presence – interact and build relationships with clients and other team members
* Analytical thinking \- ability to perform detailed, quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary). Synthesize and present insights and recommendations from data
* Logical structuring \- structured approach to problem solving and ability to perform root cause analysis of client problems
* Deadline\-oriented and quality focused \- develop and own development of deliverables. Own and manage specific work\-thread, develop plans for components of engagement, manage and mentor junior resources
* Collaboration \- Be able to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels. Be able to prioritize tasks, manage change in scope, work on multiple assignments, and raise concerns/questions where appropriate
* Network \- ability to chart one’s own career and build networks within the organization


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant STEM Field (ex. Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics) from a premier school in India or abroad
* MBA, MS, M. Tech. from a premier school in India or abroad, with a background in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, etc.
* 4\+ years (for Senior Consultants) of relevant experience in in roles involving technology strategy, enterprise architecture, digital transformation, or large\-scale infrastructure and cloud initiatives
* Relevant certifications in hybrid cloud/AI infrastructure space would be nice to have (e.g., TOGAF, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, CISM, CISSP, CEH)


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people.  At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. title: Lead HashiVault Engineer [T500-29209]
description:
**Talent500 is hiring for one of its clients.** 




**Who are we:** 




 Core Insurance Platforms (CIP) is Zurich’s global capability responsible for building, running, and evolving core insurance technology. We set a unified, scalable operating model—covering governance, standards, architecture, service delivery, and reuse—so our business units can deliver at speed and scale.
 



 CIP is the strategic steward of Zurich’s Guidewire ecosystem, aligning platform roadmaps to business strategy while driving stability, modernization, reduced supplier dependency, and long term cost efficiency.
 



 India delivery center is one of our global delivery and capability hub. We bring together experts in AI, engineering, analysis, quality, and architecture to deliver product \& process solutions, application run services, change and transformation initiatives, and centralized platform services across both on prem and Guidewire Cloud environments. Our teams operate from multiple global delivery centers, supporting Zurich’s business units worldwide.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Secrets Management Engineer to own, evolve, and secure our enterprise secrets management platform. You will be the subject matter expert for tools such as HashiCorp Vault (or equivalent), driving adoption, best practices, and engineering standards across the organisation.
 



 This is a high\-impact, hands\-on technical role at the intersection of cybersecurity, DevSecOps, and infrastructure engineering. You will work closely with platform, cloud, and application engineering teams to ensure secrets — credentials, certificates, API keys, encryption keys — are managed securely, at scale, and in line with zero\-trust principles.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Platform Ownership \& Engineering:** 



* Design, deploy, and operate a highly available, scalable secrets management platform (e.g. HashiCorp Vault Enterprise, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, CyberArk).
* Define and enforce secrets management architecture, policies, and standards across multi\-cloud and hybrid environments.
* Manage Vault clusters including HA configuration, replication, auto\-unseal (e.g. via AWS KMS or Azure Key Vault), and disaster recovery.
* Build and maintain Terraform/IaC modules, Helm charts, and automation pipelines for platform deployment and configuration.
* Own the full lifecycle of secrets: creation, rotation, revocation, leasing, and auditing.



  





**Security \& Compliance:** 



* Implement and maintain dynamic secrets, PKI certificate management, and database credential rotation.
* Develop and enforce RBAC, ACL policies, and names pacing within Vault to enforce least\-privilege access.
* Conduct regular access reviews, audit log analysis, and security assessments of the secrets platform.
* Ensure compliance with relevant frameworks and regulations including ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI\-DSS, and NIST guidelines.
* Drive zero\-trust architecture principles across secrets distribution and access patterns.



  





**DevSecOps \& Integration:** 



* Integrate secrets management tooling with CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI) to eliminate hard\-coded credentials.
* Build Vault Agent, sidecar injection, and Kubernetes Secrets Store CSI Driver integrations for containerised workloads.
* Partner with application and DevOps teams to migrate away from legacy secrets handling patterns toward dynamic, short\-lived credentials.
* Develop SDKs, libraries, and internal tooling to simplify developer adoption of secrets management APIs.



  





**Leadership \& Enablement:** 



* Act as the internal SME and evangelist for secrets management — mentoring engineers and running enablement sessions.
* Define and own the secrets management roadmap, balancing security uplift with engineering velocity.
* Produce and maintain runbooks, architecture documentation, and operational procedures.
* Collaborate with security architecture, risk, and compliance teams on controls and evidence for audits.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience:** 




**Essential:** 



* 5\+ years in a cybersecurity, infrastructure, or platform engineering role, with at least 3 years of hands\-on HashiCorp Vault (or equivalent) experience.
* Deep expertise in Vault architecture: cluster setup, auth methods (AppRole, Kubernetes, AWS IAM, LDAP, OIDC), secret engines, policies, and audit devices.
* Strong scripting and automation skills — Python, Bash, Go, or similar.
* Infrastructure as Code proficiency — Terraform, Ansible, or Pulumi.
* Experience with Kubernetes and container\-native secrets injection patterns (CSI driver, Vault Agent Injector).
* Solid understanding of PKI, TLS/mTLS, certificate lifecycle management, and encryption key management (HSM experience a plus).
* Familiarity with cloud\-native secrets services across AWS (Secrets Manager, KMS, Parameter Store), Azure (Key Vault), and/or GCP (Secret Manager).
* Strong understanding of zero\-trust architecture, least\-privilege access, and RBAC.
* Experience with CI/CD pipeline integration and secrets hygiene in software delivery.



  





**Desirable:** 



* HashiCorp Vault Associate or Professional certification.
* Experience with CyberArk, Conjur, or other PAM/secrets platforms.
* Exposure to SIEM integration and secrets\-related threat detection (e.g. detecting credential misuse via audit logs).
* Experience in a regulated environment (financial services, healthcare, government).
* Familiarity with service mesh and mTLS patterns (Istio, Consul Connect).
* Open\-source contributions or public technical writing related to secrets management.



  





**What We Offer:** 



* Competitive salary and performance\-based bonus.
* Flexible hybrid working arrangements.
* Dedicated learning and certification budget (including HashiCorp, cloud, and security certifications).
* Exposure to a complex, large\-scale, multi\-cloud environment.
* Collaborative, psychologically safe team culture with a genuine security\-first mission.
* Private healthcare, pension, and additional benefits package.



*We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from all backgrounds. This job description is indicative and may be subject to change in line with business needs.*

title: Mulesoft Technical Manager
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
 Job Category
   

  

 Customer Success
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

 MuleSoft’s Professional Services team works across technology and business stakeholders to usher customers into the next phase of their business transformation journey and achieve innovative outcomes that shape the future.
   

  

**As a Practice Manager, You Get To**
 Lead a team of technical architects and consultants as they deliver MuleSoft solutions to our customers. In addition to people leadership, career coaching, and project oversight responsibilities for the team, you will build our practice through leading internal initiatives, contributing to the technical practice business plan, developing methodology, creating team enablement, onboarding new architects, and recruiting to build the team.
   

  

 This role is 50% billable and in addition to team leadership, you will work with our customers and partners to solve critically important business challenges using MuleSoft’s Anypoint Platform. You will lead customer, partner, and MuleSoft technical teams through multi\-phased delivery projects and provide hands\-on delivery guidance to influence standards for development, governance, and the operational life cycle.
   

  

 You will be a key member of the cross\-functional MuleSoft leadership team. Collaboration and alignment across Sales, Customer Success, Pre\-Sales, and Product teams will be integral to your success.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead a team of technical architects and consultants as they deliver MuleSoft solutions to our customers.
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce and MuleSoft environments, optimizing API performance, data orchestration, and platform resource consumption
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document complex integration solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI\-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate API implementation and integration lifecycle velocity across projects
* Provide hands\-on delivery guidance to influence standards for development, governance, and the operational life cycle.
* Build our practice through leading internal initiatives, contributing to the technical practice business plan, developing methodology, creating team enablement, onboarding new architects, and recruiting to build the team.
* Collaborate and align across Sales, Customer Success, Pre\-Sales, and Product teams to ensure customer success.
* Maintain a target billable utilization and manage operational excellence when it comes to bookings and utilization forecasting.


**To be successful, you have**
* 12\+ years experience leading by example and being a player and a coach.
* A background as a professional services leader with experience growing a practice and a strong consulting background in a credible system integrator firm or high growth enterprise software vendor.
* A collaborative mindset and the ability to gain trust with your team and across internal and external functional leaders.
* Experience architecting MuleSoft services integrations including a solid understanding of on\-premise and cloud\-based infrastructures, SDLC pipelines, configuration, and deployment.
* Experience with API and integration security with a solid grasp of authentication and authorization concepts and principles.
* 6\-10 years of proven track record leading integration teams and architecting solutions within a diverse technical team of clients, system integrators, contractors, and internal teams.
* A background in conducting technical workshops with technical and business clients to drive effective services and implementations.
* The ability to communicate complex technical concepts in a simple yet comprehensive way to non\-technical and technical professionals alike.
* A desire for continuous study of new technologies and functionality, and involvement in projects that push the capabilities of existing technologies.
* An appreciation for operational excellence when it comes to bookings and utilization forecast, contract terms, etc.
* Excellent verbal and written technical documentation skills.
* Experience managing people and projects in a matrix'd environment.
* Ability to establish credibility with smart engineers quickly, motivate people, instill accountability, and achieve results.
* Agile, proactive, comfortable working with ambiguous specifications and can prioritize on the fly.
* Knowledge of MuleSoft AI developments such as Mule AI Chain, Topic Center, API Catalog, MCP, Agentforce Connectors.
* Familiarity with AI \& ML concepts, including predictive and generative AI, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), Large Language Models (LLMs), and Agentic AI.
* Passion for continuous learning and experimentation with emerging AI technologies, including prompt engineering, new LLM models, and agentic AI frameworks.
* Basic understanding of Agentforce and building AI agents (Good to have).


**Desired Skills**
* Experience developing with Continuous Integration (CI) pipelines.
* Knowledge on publish \& subscribe integration design models.
* Experience using Jenkins and Nexus technologies.
* Experience with solutions on Salesforce products/platform technologies (Experience building Service Cloud applications is a definite plus).
* Ability to learn quickly in a highly dynamic environment.
* Ability to take ownership of project delivery and multi\-task on multiple projects/feature development.
* Bachelor degree in computer science or equivalent is desired (Masters would be preferred).


 Unleash Your Potential
   

  

 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
 *be your best* 
 , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
 *do your best* 
 . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
   

  

 Accommodations
   

  

 If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
   

  

 Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
   

  

 Posting Statement
   

  

 Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non\-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. title: Principal, Terraform Engineering
description:
**About Northern Trust**
 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
   

  

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
   

  

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
   

  

**Principal, Terraform Engineering
   

  

 Role Overview**
 We are seeking a highly experienced engineering leader with
 **15\+ years of expertise** 
 in infrastructure automation and cloud engineering. As the Principal Terraform Engineering Lead, you will drive the
 **innovative adoption of Infrastructure as Code (IaC)** 
 across Azure, AWS, and on\-premise private cloud platforms. This role is pivotal in establishing
 **Terraform best practices, standardization, resiliency, and observability** 
 while leading the enterprise\-wide adoption of Terraform Enterprise within a large financial organization.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Strategic Leadership: Define and lead the enterprise\-wide Terraform adoption strategy, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and regulatory requirements.
* Infrastructure as Code Excellence: Architect and implement standardized IaC frameworks across multi\-cloud and hybrid environments (Azure, AWS, private cloud).
* Terraform Enterprise Adoption: Drive rollout, governance, and operationalization of Terraform Enterprise at scale across global teams.
* DevOps Expertise: SME in driving DevOps CICD in IaC implementation.
* Resiliency \& Observability: Embed resiliency, monitoring, and observability into IaC practices to ensure robust and compliant infrastructure delivery.
* Standardization \& Governance: Establish enterprise\-wide standards, guardrails, and reusable modules to accelerate adoption and reduce risk.
* Hands\-on Engineering: Provide technical leadership and hands\-on expertise in Terraform, cloud automation, and infrastructure modernization.
* Collaboration \& Influence: Partner with product engineering, risk governance, and infrastructure teams to drive adoption and innovation.
* Continuous Improvement: Champion automation, efficiency, and secure delivery practices across the organization.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 15\+ years of progressive experience in infrastructure engineering, automation, and cloud technologies.
* Deep hands\-on expertise in Terraform (Open Source \& Enterprise), with proven ability to design and scale IaC solutions.
* Strong architectural background in multi\-cloud (Azure, AWS) and private cloud platforms.
* Experience driving enterprise\-wide adoption of IaC frameworks in regulated industries.
* Proven ability to embed resiliency, observability, and compliance into infrastructure delivery pipelines.
* Strong leadership edge with experience as a global service owner or platform lead.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and ability to influence senior stakeholders.


**Preferred Background**
* Experience in financial services or global banking organizations.
* Familiarity with regulatory compliance frameworks (ISO, NIST, DORA, PRA, CSA CCM).
* Expertise in cloud modernization, automation frameworks, and operational resilience.


**Leadership Attributes**
* Visionary leader with the ability to transform infrastructure delivery at scale.
* Collaborative and influential communicator across global teams and executive stakeholders.
* Recognized as a trusted advisor and problem solver in infrastructure modernization.
* Passionate about driving innovation, standardization, and resilience in technology delivery.


**Working with Us**
 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
   

  

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
   

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**
 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
   

  

**About Our Pune Office**
 The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
   

  

 Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

 Virtual Machines

 Networking and identity (Azure AD)

 Lead projects, deployments, and client IT transformations.
   

 Coordinate with sales, project, and management teams for solution delivery.

 Provide reports on incident trends, problem resolutions, and improvement areas.

 Technical Skills

 Windows Server \& Active Directory
   

 HyperV / VMware virtualization
   

 Backup solutions (Veeam, Acronis, Synology)
   

 M365 \& Azure administration
   

 NAS/SAN storage \& surveillance systems
   

 Strong handson troubleshooting and rootcause analysis skills.

 Leadership qualities, mentoring ability, and ownership mindset.

 Strong documentation and presentation skills.

title: Senior Cloud Migration Engineer / Architect (AWS to GCP Migration)
description:
SourceFuse Technologies hiring Senior Cloud Migration Engineer / Architect (AWS to GCP Migration) with 6\+ years of experience.
 



  





**Preferred Location\- Noida/Mohali** 




**Key Responsibilities** 




**Migration Strategy and Delivery Leadership** 



* Own the end to end technical strategy for the AWS to GCP migration, including target architecture, migration sequencing, and cutover approach.
* Produce and maintain the Technical Design Document (TDD), including low level component diagrams, at a level of detail a client engineering team can implement against.
* Establish and maintain a Key Design Decision (KDD) log capturing the rationale for major architecture choices, for example service equivalency decisions such as Cloud Run versus other compute options.
* Build and maintain a Migration and Rollback Plan, and an accurate, current Component Inventory of everything in scope for migration.
* Run weekly governance and status reporting, and maintain a Deliverables and Acceptances Log so the client always has a clear, current record of what has been delivered and approved.



  





**Migration Execution** 



* Diagnose and resolve codebase divergence between environments, including establishing a snapshot and reconciliation approach where none currently exists.
* Lead migration of core services, including compute, container workloads, and identity/authentication, from the source cloud to GCP equivalents.
* Own data migration validation where the target uses a different database engine than the source (for example, a document or key\-value store migration such as DynamoDB to Firestore), including building or reviewing validation scripts and consistency reports.
* Define and implement a cross\-cloud connectivity approach (private networking between environments) for the duration of the migration.
* Define the scope and implementation of any cross\-cloud abstraction layer required to keep the platform portable during and after migration.
* Plan and execute large scale data and feed migrations (dozens of independent feeds or integrations), with a clear enablement and validation package for each.
* Migrate logging and observability tooling, for example a self\-managed ELK stack, to GCP native or GCP\-compatible equivalents, with log routing fully validated before cutover.



  





**Infrastructure and Compatibility** 



* Build and maintain the target GCP landing zone and core infrastructure using IaC, Terraform preferred, so environments are repeatable, reviewable, and version controlled.
* Own the CI/CD pipeline build for the new environment.
* Drive remediation of the service compatibility assessment, translating flagged incompatible services into a prioritized, sequenced backlog ahead of cutover.
* Review pull requests from client engineers where the client team is doing migration work in parallel, and keep that work aligned to the agreed target design.



  





**Cutover and Post\-Migration** 



* Plan and lead the production cutover, including go and no go criteria, rollback triggers, and a data consistency and parity validation approach.
* Produce platform documentation and operational runbooks, and lead technical handover and enablement sessions for the client's internal team.
* Provide a defined period of post\-cutover expert advisory support, including an operational protocol and escalation matrix.



  





**Required Skills and Experience** 



* Proven experience leading at least one large scale, production cloud migration end to end, from planning through cutover, ideally cross\-cloud.
* Deep, hands on GCP experience across compute (Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud Run, App Engine), data and storage (Firestore, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, Bigtable, Memorystore), and networking (VPC, Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud NAT, Cloud DNS).
* Working familiarity with AWS is useful for reading and reasoning about the source environment, for example Cognito, DynamoDB, and Lambda, though deep AWS expertise is not required for this role.
* Advanced Terraform experience, including reusable modules, state management, and automated deployment workflows.
* Experience migrating between different database engines, including designing or validating data consistency and correctness checks.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across distributed systems, using Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, and Cloud Audit Logs for root cause analysis.
* Demonstrated ability to write clear technical design documentation, and to run structured governance and status reporting for a client or stakeholder audience.
* Comfortable owning ambiguous, partially defined scope and turning it into a documented, sequenced plan under time pressure.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience migrating identity and authentication between cloud providers, for example Cognito to an equivalent GCP or third party identity service.
* Experience migrating self\-managed Elasticsearch or ELK deployments to managed or cloud native alternatives.
* Working knowledge of cloud security fundamentals, such as IAM, least privilege, Secret Manager, and VPC Service Controls, sufficient to keep the migrated environment secure by design. This is not primarily a security hardening role.
* Experience standing up a post go\-live managed services capability: ongoing monitoring, operational efficiency improvements, and automated operational actions.
* Experience with data sovereignty sensitive or regulated workloads, and with multi\-region deployments.
