description:
**Description**
 Do you have the business savvy and technical background to help establish Amazon Web Services as the preferred cloud platform for India's IT and ITeS industry? AWS India is seeking a results\-driven Account Manager to accelerate cloud adoption across one of India's most dynamic and globally influential sectors.
   

  

 AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer\-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.
   

  

 As an Account Manager for the IT/ITeS segment, you will be responsible for driving AWS adoption across IT services companies, software product firms, and technology\-enabled services organizations. You will build strategic relationships with technology leaders, influence cloud architecture decisions, and help these organizations leverage AWS to deliver innovative solutions to their global customers while transforming their own operations.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities

You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. * Deliver Migration Solutions: Design and implement migration strategies for hybrid cloud platforms, utilizing rehost, refactor, rearchitect, replatform, and containerization techniques to ensure seamless transitions.

* Collaborate on Migration Tools: Work with stakeholders to identify and utilize effective migration tools, considering network requirements, application, database, and integration component migration pathways.

 Master's Degree

* Cloud Migration Solution Delivery: Exposure to delivering cloud migration solutions, leveraging software architecture fundamentals, assets, and tools, such as the garage method for cloud.

* Containerization and Migration Techniques: Exposure to rehost, refactor, rearchitect, replatform, and containerization techniques for seamless transitions.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Hybrid Cloud Platform Knowledge: Experience working with hybrid cloud platforms, including designing and implementing migration strategies, is beneficial. Understanding of architecture implementation and migration tool utilization is also valuable.

description:

* Lead the technical review of Snowflake infrastructure SAP integration pipelines and the bronze/raw ingestion layer.

* External volumes and storage integration configuration
* Infrastructure\-as\-code for Snowflake (Terraform provider, schema change or similar)

* Experience assessing SAP\-to\-cloud integration pipelines from a platform (not functional/SAP\-module) perspective.

title: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Architect
description:
Company Description
 
 Genetrix Technology operates at the forefront of the Marketing Technology industry, delivering enterprise\-grade marketing automation solutions with innovation and precision. We specialize in Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Account Engagement (Pardot), Data Cloud, Marketing Cloud Growth, Braze, and related technologies.
 



 We help businesses optimize their marketing operations, strengthen customer engagement, and drive measurable growth through scalable technology and strategic expertise. At Genetrix Technology, we are committed to helping organizations achieve new levels of marketing success.
 



  





  




 Role Description
 
 The Salesforce Marketing Cloud Architect will be responsible for designing scalable, secure, and high\-performing marketing technology solutions across Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud, and the broader Salesforce ecosystem.
 



 This is a senior, client\-facing role that combines solution architecture, technical leadership, hands\-on implementation, and delivery oversight. The architect will lead discovery workshops, define end\-to\-end solution designs, guide development teams, and ensure that implementations follow platform best practices.
 



 The ideal candidate should be capable of translating complex business and marketing requirements into practical technical solutions while confidently communicating architectural decisions, dependencies, risks, and trade\-offs to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
   




 Key Responsibilities
 * Lead technical discovery and solution\-design workshops with clients and internal stakeholders.
* Understand clients’ business objectives, customer journeys, data sources, marketing processes, security requirements, and integration needs.
* Design end\-to\-end solutions across Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud, Marketing Cloud Personalization, Marketing Cloud Intelligence, Agentforce Marketing, and connected Salesforce products.
* Define scalable solution architecture covering data models, integrations, automations, identity resolution, consent management, personalization, and channel activation.
* Produce solution\-design documents, architecture diagrams, data\-flow diagrams, integration specifications, and technical implementation plans.
* Evaluate architectural options and clearly explain technical decisions, risks, dependencies, limitations, and trade\-offs.
* Design and oversee email, SMS, mobile, web, advertising, and omnichannel customer\-engagement solutions.
* Architect complex Journey Builder programs, Automation Studio workflows, audience segmentation, personalization, and reusable campaign frameworks.
* Design scalable Marketing Cloud data models using Data Extensions, Contact Builder, synchronized data sources, and enterprise data architecture best practices.
* Define integration patterns using REST and SOAP APIs, Marketing Cloud Connect, middleware platforms, SFTP, webhooks, and batch or real\-time processes.
* Provide architectural guidance for Marketing Cloud Engagement implementations, migrations, consolidations, business\-unit structures, and multi\-cloud solutions.
* Ensure solutions follow best practices for security, consent, privacy, deliverability, performance, scalability, and data governance.
* Review technical designs, code, configurations, SQL queries, AMPscript, SSJS, APIs, and automation processes.
* Troubleshoot complex platform, integration, data, performance, and campaign\-execution issues.
* Lead and mentor Marketing Cloud consultants and developers, ensuring high\-quality delivery and adherence to technical standards.
* Establish and enforce development standards, naming conventions, documentation practices, deployment processes, and code\-review guidelines.
* Work closely with project managers to define scope, estimates, timelines, resource requirements, dependencies, and delivery risks.
* Support pre\-sales activities, including solution discovery, technical presentations, effort estimation, proposals, and proof\-of\-concept development.
* Liaise with Salesforce product and support teams to resolve platform issues and support client implementations.
* Stay current with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud, Agentforce, and wider MarTech platform developments.
* Maintain billable utilization aligned with the expectations of the role.
* Collaborate remotely with global teams and remain flexible with working hours when required for international client delivery.



  




 Required Qualifications and Experience
 * 8–12 years of overall experience in marketing technology, CRM, or enterprise solution delivery.
* At least 6 years of deep, hands\-on experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
* Proven experience working as a Marketing Cloud Architect, Technical Architect, or Senior Technical Consultant on enterprise implementations.
* Strong expertise in Marketing Cloud Engagement, including Email Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Contact Builder, Mobile Studio, and Content Builder.
* Strong understanding of enterprise data architecture, subscriber management, Contact Key strategy, data retention, and large\-data\-volume considerations.
* Experience designing multi\-business\-unit and multi\-cloud Marketing Cloud implementations.
* Strong knowledge of AMPscript, SSJS, SQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and dynamic content development.
* Experience designing responsive emails, CloudPages, preference centres, landing pages, forms, and reusable content frameworks.
* Strong knowledge of Salesforce Marketing Cloud REST and SOAP APIs.
* Experience designing batch, near\-real\-time, and real\-time integration patterns.
* Good understanding of Marketing Cloud Connect and integration with Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Commerce Cloud.
* Experience with authentication, security, API packages, OAuth, SFTP, middleware, and third\-party integrations.
* Familiarity with Data Cloud concepts, including data ingestion, data modelling, identity resolution, calculated insights, segmentation, and activation.
* Familiarity with Marketing Cloud Personalization, Marketing Cloud Intelligence, Marketing Cloud Growth, and Agentforce Marketing.
* Strong understanding of consent management, data privacy, email deliverability, sender reputation, and communication compliance.
* Ability to design scalable and performance\-driven solutions while considering platform limits and operational maintainability.
* Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to investigate complex data, integration, automation, and campaign issues.
* Experience leading technical teams, conducting code reviews, and mentoring consultants and developers.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to business stakeholders and technical teams.
* Experience managing client expectations, delivery risks, and technical escalations.



  




 Preferred Qualifications
 * Experience working in a consulting, agency, or system\-integration environment.
* Experience delivering solutions for clients across multiple industries and geographies.
* Knowledge of Braze or other enterprise marketing automation platforms.
* Experience with CI/CD, version control, deployment automation, and Marketing Cloud DevOps practices.
* Experience supporting solution estimation, proposal development, technical demonstrations, and pre\-sales discussions.
* Understanding of Salesforce Well\-Architected principles and enterprise architecture frameworks.



  





  





 Candidates should hold active Salesforce certifications or be willing and able to achieve the relevant certifications after joining.

In this role, you will be instrumental in developing comprehensive cloud strategies, creating scalable and secure AWS environments, and guiding clients through seamless migrations from on\-premises infrastructure to the cloud and manage Cloud BAU operations.


**Responsibilities Include:**

* Your responsibilities will include developing and implementing scalable AWS architectures, focusing on modernizing VMware workloads and ensuring robust, secure, and cost\-effective cloud environments.
* You will design and deploy AWS landing zones to establish a secure, multi\-account AWS environment, adhering to best practices for compliance, security, and account management.
* Leading initiatives to modernize on\-premises VMware environments by leveraging AWS services (e.g., VMware to EC2\) and developing strategies for re\-platforming and refactoring applications will be a key part of your role.
* Additionally, you will manage the planning and execution of cloud migration projects, including assessments, dependency mapping, migration strategy, and risk mitigation.
* Partnering with clients to understand their business requirements, define project scope, and ensure successful cloud transformation outcomes will be essential.
* Ensuring all designs and implementations comply with AWS best practices, security policies, and relevant industry standards is crucial.
* You will utilize Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) tools, such as AWS CloudFormation, Terraform, and Ansible, to automate deployment and management processes.
* Optimizing cloud environments for cost, performance, and scalability while following AWS best practices and governance frameworks will be part of your responsibilities.
* Finally, you will produce and maintain detailed architectural documentation, operational procedures, and best practice guidelines, and provide training to internal teams and clients on cloud adoption and management.

  

**Your future at Kyndryl**  

This role opens the door to many career paths, both vertical and horizontal, and there may be opportunity to travel. It’s a great chance for database administrators or other techs to break into the cloud. It’s also a solid path to become enterprise or architect or a distinguished engineer! Whatever you see for yourself, you’ll find the opportunity here.  



  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  

  

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

* Minimum of 10\+ years of experience as a solutions expert or in a similar role, with at least **8\+ years working specifically with AWS.**
* Proficiency with AWS services (VPC, EC2, IAM, Lambda, S3, RDS, CloudTrail, etc.) and Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) tools such as CloudFormation, Terraform, or Ansible.
* Knowledge of AWS security practices, compliance requirements, and tools (IAM, AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, and GuardDuty).
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automation frameworks to support continuous delivery and integration.
* Good understanding and hands\-on in managing Dynamo DB / Kinesis / lambda / SQS / SNS / DevOps services.
* Hands on DevOps and CI/CD automation tools such as Git, Jenkins, Terra form, Ansible, and cloud native scripting such as Cloud Formation and ARM templates
* Should have strong knowledge on Certificate management, Encryption keys management, Load Balancers etc.
* Proven experience in designing and building AWS landing zones to support secure, multi\-account architectures.
* Strong experience with cloud migration projects, including workload assessment, migration planning, and execution, with expertise in tools such as AWS Migration Hub and AWS Server Migration Service.
* Datadog integration setup / management hands on.
* Designing the cloud infra solution as per customer requirement
* Problem solving and conflict resolution skills.

**Note: This position is to support the night shift 9:30 PM IST – 5:30 AM IST to support the Japan non\-business hours cloud operations.**

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

* AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional)
* Experience in hybrid cloud environments and multi\-cloud strategies.
* Familiarity with server less architecture and microservices design.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

title: Senior Architect - GCI
description:
Senior Solutions Architect — Governance, Compliance, \& Insights
   

  

 Why Join Us?
   

  

 The interesting work in enterprise security has moved inside the organization. AI agents are creating new insider risk and compliance obligations every day. Data is sprawling faster than the controls around it. At Mimecast, our product lines sit where all of that converges.
   

  

 This is an architecture role reporting directly to an Enterprise Architect (EA). You’ll work alongside other Solutions Architects on the team to shape how the product evolves, how it integrates with the rest of Mimecast, and how it stays ahead of where the market is going.
   

  

 The Solutions Architect role at Mimecast sits closer to the product problem. Discovery, shaping, and contract design now drive more of the value than detailed component design. If you primarily want to be a heads\-down individual contributor, this isn’t the right seat. If you want to shape what gets built and own the structural decisions that make a product line move fast with quality, it is.
   

  

 AI\-First Architecture at Mimecast
   

  

 Mimecast is an AI\-First engineering organization. We expect this role to use AI development tools daily — for design exploration, prototyping, documentation, code review, and analysis. This is not optional and it is not bolt\-on; it is how we work.
   

  

 You will also be designing systems that incorporate AI directly. This product line is actively building agent\-aware detections and AI\-driven enrichment, and contributing to Mimecast’s broader AI\-powered risk products. Comfort designing with — and for — LLMs, agents, and modern AI architectures is core to this job, not a side interest.
   

  

 We treat architecture artifacts — ADRs, AGENTS.md files (agent\-readable repo context), and data contracts — as machine\-readable context, not documentation. They’re the substrate that humans and agents both operate inside, and they capture the reasoning behind design decisions — the why, not just the what.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 This is a leadership role shaping the future of Mimecast's Governance, Compliance \& Insight (GCI) suite. GCI helps organizations manage data governance, retention, and compliance at scale. Our products include email \& collaboration archiving, eDiscovery, compliance management, data retention, audit capabilities, and analytics, alongside our new AI\-powered governance and compliance tools.
   

  

 You will be the connective tissue across product management, user experience, and engineering to translate real customer problems into effective, efficient solutions. You will help the team unlock value across Mimecast’s entire portfolio to help customers navigate the human and agentic risks they face every day.
   

  

 We operate with a sense of urgency. Cyber threats don't wait, and neither do we. You'll lead teams that move fast, make decisions with conviction, and deliver results. We expect leaders who thrive in this environment and inspire the same urgency in the teams around you.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Shape problems with product partners: Contribute at the problem\-framing stage, not just after requirements land. Run and facilitate workshops with product managers, engineers, UX designers, and subject matter experts to surface user needs, constraints, and opportunities. Define what “good” looks like in customer and business terms before settling on a technical shape.
* Own integration contracts as product artifacts: Help define how the product line touches the rest of the Mimecast platform. You’ll own the durable interfaces — APIs, events, and data contracts. You’ll also do the coordination work that makes integrations actually land.
* Build the architectural context engineering teams operate inside: ADRs, data contracts, and service interaction patterns. These are how architecture decisions get propagated and enforced at scale across humans and agents — they’re part of the build system, not the wiki.
* Set NFR and evaluability targets: Performance, availability, security, cost — help define the targets with real numbers. For AI features, extend that to eval coverage, agent boundary safety, and prompt/data\-contract stability.
* Coordinate across teams and organizations: A lot of the impact in this role comes from getting the right people in the room, gathering stakeholder buy\-in, and shepherding decisions to closure.
* Engage Enterprise Architecture bidirectionally: Bring cross\-product and platform\-level decisions to the EA for alignment. Pull EA\-level constraints into product shaping early. Push back when standards don’t fit your situation, with a clear case.
* Estimate and monitor cost and unit economics: Provide cost projections for new architecture work; flag unexpected spend and propose remediation. Reason about cost per outcome — per protected user, per investigated incident, per inference — not just AWS spend.
* Wear a technical\-architect hat when it adds value: Default mode is solution and product shaping. Drop into detailed technical design when the problem warrants it or when you’re unblocking a team — and know when to step back out. With agentic engineering practices in place, more of the detailed implementation work is carried by engineers with AI assistance.
* Propose technical debt work: Identify and prioritize debt reduction with Product Management partners.


 What You’ll Bring
   

  

* Architecture experience at scale: 8\+ years building and operating production systems, and engaging with product early in the cycle. Time as a Solutions Architect, Principal Engineer, Tech Lead, Product Architect, Staff Engineer, or equivalent. Comfortable owning architecture across multiple teams.
* Cloud\-native depth: Strong working knowledge of AWS (ECS/EKS, S3, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS, IAM, VPC), Kafka, and the ability to reason about distributed systems at high volume. You don’t need deeper AWS internals knowledge than the senior engineers — you need to reason about system shape and trade\-offs.
* Contract\-first integration thinking: A track record of designing clean contracts between systems and teams — async messaging, event streaming, REST/gRPC APIs, data contracts — and a clear point of view on when to reach for which.
* Product partnership: Comfortable working with PMs on problem definition, customer research synthesis, jobs\-to\-be\-done framing, and outcome hypotheses. You have a point of view on what makes a good product bet, not just a good technical bet.
* AI\-First working style: You actively use AI development tools day\-to\-day and have a real opinion on where they help and where they don’t. You’re comfortable designing systems that include LLMs, agents, retrieval, or related components — or you’re hungry to get there fast.
* Strong written and verbal communication: Can write a one\-page ADR that lands, draft a solution brief that holds up under EA review, and lead a whiteboard session that produces a decision. Equally comfortable with engineers, PMs, and designers.
* Stakeholder navigation: Good at building consensus across teams and organizations. Comfortable with ambiguity.
* Self\-direction: Driven, accountable, and able to identify the right problems to work on without being told. The team is small and senior — you’ll be expected to lead, not wait for direction.
* Bonus points: Background in security, compliance, eDiscovery, identity, observability, or data platforms. Familiarity with agentic AI, MCP (Model Context Protocol), or LLM application architecture. Experience with eval design for AI systems, product discovery practices, or data contract / data mesh approaches (e.g., ODCS).


 What We Offer
   

  

* Impact: Your architecture decisions will shape one of Mimecast’s fastest\-evolving product lines and protect data inside thousands of enterprises.
* Voice: Direct working relationship with senior architecture leadership and a real say in technology direction across the product line — and beyond, as opportunities present themselves.
* Modern stack and modern ways of working: AWS managed services, Kafka, modern Java and Kotlin services, a growing AI tooling footprint, and a team that defaults to ship\-and\-iterate over review\-and\-gate.
* Senior peers: A small architecture team where everyone is operating at a high level and trust runs deep.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.
* 8\+ years of professional software engineering and architecture experience, with at least 2 years in a Solutions Architect, Principal Engineer, Tech Lead, Product Architect, Staff Engineer, or similar role with significant product\-shaping responsibility.
* Willingness and drive to use AI development tools in a professional setting.


**Belonging at Mimecast**
 Cybersecurity is a community effort. That’s why we’re committed to building an inclusive, diverse community that celebrates and welcomes everyone – unless they’re a cybercriminal, of course.

title: Sr. Staff Engineer - C++
description:
**Senior Staff Engineer \- C\+\+**


**Let’s be unstoppable together!**


Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high\-quality data set.

  



At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives. We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work. Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana. Learn more at www.circana.com.

  


**Role Overview:**



We are seeking Senior Staff Engineer to drive design, evolution, and execution of our next\-generation, massively parallel processing (MPP) clustered database engine (Whitebox) that currently powers large\-scale retail and consumer analytics solutions across Circana clients in 22\+ countries and serving millions of queries every day in real\-time against massive data sets . This is a highly technical role for an expert who bridges the gap between High\-Performance Computing (HPC) and Big Data systems engineering and low\-latency machine learning infrastructure and involves database internals, distributed systems, performance engineering, data processing at scale.

  



In this role, you will be one of the primary designers and developer responsible for building low\-latency, high\-throughput distributed database kernels. You will design bare\-metal optimized software layers, ensuring our database product fully exploits modern multi\-core, vectorized hardware and distributed network fabrics to process terabyte/petabyte\-scale datasets and where appropriate, seamlessly executes highly performant analytics and in\-database ML inference directly on relational and the occasional vector datasets.

  


**Job Responsibilities:**


* **Architecture \& Design:** Play a key role in core architectural choices and roadmap for our distributed database kernel, including query execution engines, custom/hybrid columnar storage layers, distributed transaction managers, and cluster coordination protocols.
* **Low\-Level Development:** Write, optimize, and maintain highly performant, production\-ready backend code utilizing modern C\+\+ (C\+\+20/23\).
* **Parallel Execution Planning:** Architect MPP execution engines that distribute, schedule, and execute queries across several dozens to hundreds of nodes using MPI and hybrid OpenMP models.
* **Hardware Optimization:** Profile and eliminate execution bottlenecks by implementing explicit SIMD vectorization (AVX\-512, ARM Neon, SVE) and ensuring absolute cache locality (L1/L2/L3\).
* **Distributed Memory \& Networks:** Design ultra\-low latency cluster communication subsystems utilizing RDMA, RoCE, or kernel\-bypass tech (DPDK).
* **In\-Database ML Framework Design:** Architect and implement a native, highly performant, zero\-copy ML execution framework directly inside the MPP engine to eliminate data serialization and transport bottlenecks between the database and external AI pipelines.
* **Functional \& High\-Performance Algorithms:** Develop mathematically rigorous, cache\-oblivious, and highly vectorized algorithms for real\-time statistical computations, matrix operations/manipulations on clustered data
* **Vector \& Embedding Infrastructure:** Design and optimize or embed/reference distributed high\-dimensional vector storage subsystems, custom SIMD\-accelerated indexing structures (e.g., HNSW, IVF\-PQ), and parallelized approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search algorithms.
* Be comfortable working in a cross country/multi time zone team of elite systems engineers, implementing as well as conducting rigorous peer design and development reviews
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams in defining and developing new platform capabilities.
* Actively participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and technical mentoring.
* Investigate and resolve complex performance and scalability issues.

  


**Required Technical Qualifications:**


* Minimum \- 4 years Computer Science engineering degree from a reputed institute. Masters in HPC (high performance computing) and Bigdata engineering areas preferred for Senior staff engineer and above roles
* **Modern C\+\+ Expertise:** 8\+ years of production experience writing hands\-on, low\-level systems in C\+\+ (C\+\+17/20/23 preferred). Mastery of template metaprogramming, concepts, coroutines, and custom memory allocators is key.
* **HPC Parallelism:** Very good to expert\-level knowledge of cluster\-scale distributed programming using **MPI** (Message Passing Interface) paired with shared\-memory thread\-level programming via **OpenMP and MapReduce** frameworks.
* **Hardware\-Aware Engineering:** Documented experience with microarchitectural optimization, loop vectorization, pointer\-aliasing constraints, and manual **SIMD intrinsics** programming.
* **Concurrency Mechanics:** Deep understanding of OS internals, memory barriers, lock\-free data structures, and atomics (std::atomic).
* **Database Internals:** Practical experience designing core database subsystems (e.g., vectorized query operators, LSM\-trees, B\-trees, custom buffer pools, columnar serialization frameworks and query plan optimizers).
* Strong debugging, performance tuning, and problem\-solving skills.
* Proficiency in one or more leading memory and compute monitoring/performance tools (such as Valgrind, Purify, Intel/AMD/ARM diagnostics etc.)

  


**Bonus Qualifications:**


* Track record contributing to open\-source or work experience on proprietary distributed engines (e.g., ClickHouse, DuckDB, Doris, CockroachDB, RocksDB, ScyllaDB, or Velox).
* Experience with cloud\-native distributed, elastic environments, object storage tiering (S3/GCS), or zero\-copy networking.
* Experience integrating heterogeneous acceleration (NVIDIA CUDA / ROCm) into big data workloads and hybrid CPU/GPU setups.
* Vector \& Graph Algorithmic experience**:** Experience building or modifying high\-performance vector index/search engines, graph\-based indices, or localized quantization frameworks.
* Functional domain awareness – CPG, Retail, Pharma verticals

  


**What We Offer**


* Work on the bleeding edge of data infrastructure, tackling next gen big data engineering problems to support real time querying and analytics against some of the largest data sets at high concurrency
* Challenging engineering problems \- all the way from functional/data science algorithm implementations on a HPC setup to bare metal/close to OS kernel level programming involving handling of hundreds of billions of records to support real\-time analytics at scale.
* Plenty of valuable exposure to broader BI/Analytics/Bigdata ecosystem including great opportunity to functionally better understand CPG, Retail and related domains.


Stimulating work environment and a great Circana work culture that allows members to bring their best daily.

  


**Circana Behaviors:**



Beyond technical skills, experience, and role\-specific attributes, these shared behaviors are fundamental to our culture and success. We seek individuals who consistently demonstrate and champion these behaviors in their daily work:


* Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions.
* Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action.
* Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices.
* Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers.
* Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement.
* Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity.
* Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone.

  


**Location:**

This position can be located in the following area(s): Bangalore

title: Staff Engineer, Distributed Storage and HPC & AI Infrastructure
description:
### **About the Role**



In this role, you will operate, scale, and optimize multi\-petabyte storage systems purpose\-built for the world’s largest AI training and inference workloads. You’ll manage and scale high\-performance parallel filesystems and object stores, evaluate and integrate cutting\-edge technologies such as Vast, Weka, Ceph, and Lustre, and solve the complex engineering challenges of operating at extreme throughput, low\-latency data paths, and massive cluster\-scale storage operations.



You will also build Kubernetes\-native storage operators and self\-service platforms that provide automated provisioning, strict multi\-tenancy, performance isolation, and quota enforcement at cluster scale. Day\-to\-day, you’ll optimize end\-to\-end data paths for 10\-50 GB/s per node, design multi\-tier caching architectures, implement intelligent prefetching and model\-weight distribution, and tune parallel filesystems for AI workloads.


**Responsibilities**


* Architect and implement the technical strategy and storage roadmap for Together AI, driving high\-performance architectural decisions as we scale our GPU fleet.
* Engineer and scale multi\-petabyte AI/ML storage systems by integrating Vast, Weka, and Ceph while executing deep cost optimization through automated tiering and lifecycle policies.
* Develop intelligent caching and tiered storage architectures to achieve extreme IOPS and cluster\-wide throughput at GPU scale for training and inference workloads.
* Tune storage isolation at the L2/L3 network layers to ensure secure, production\-grade multi\-tenancy for storage clients.
* Code Kubernetes storage operators and controllers to enable automated provisioning, self\-service abstractions, and quota enforcement.
* Engineer end\-to\-end data paths to achieve 10\+ GB/s per GPU node; architect multi\-tier caching for model weights and datasets; tune parallel filesystems using advanced profiling; and scale storage infrastructure across thousands of nodes.
* Optimize end\-to\-end data paths through advanced benchmarking and profiling, contributing high\-impact code to open\-source storage projects and internal tooling.

### **Requirements**


* 8\+ years in storage engineering, managing distributed storage at multi\-petabyte scale
* Proven track record deploying and operating high\-performance storage for GPU/HPC clusters
* Deep Kubernetes and cloud\-native storage experience in production environments
* Strong coding skills in Go and Python with demonstrated ability to build production\-grade systems and tooling
* BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* History of technical leadership: designing systems that significantly improved performance, reliability (99\.999%\+ uptime), or cost efficiency
* Distributed Storage Systems: Deep expertise in either of Ceph, WekaFS, Lustre, Vast, GPFS, or similar parallel filesystems at multi\-petabyte scale
* Object Storage: Production experience with S3, MinIO, Ceph, or R2 including performance optimization and cost management
* Kubernetes Storage: CSI drivers, StatefulSets, PersistentVolumes, storage operators, and custom controllers
* Storage optimization for GPU workloads, RDMA/InfiniBand networking, parallel filesystem optimization (TB/s aggregate cluster throughput \- line saturation)
* Programming: Go and Python for automation, operators, and tooling
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Ansible, Helm, GitOps (ArgoCD)
* Linux Storage Stack: Advanced knowledge of filesystems (ext4, xfs), LVM, NVMe optimization, RAID configurations
* Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Thanos architecture and operations

### **Nice to Have Skills**


* GPU Direct Storage (GDS), NVMe\-oF, storage networking, RDMA implementations
* ML/AI storage patterns (model weights, checkpointing, dataset caching)
* Storage benchmarking and profiling tools (fio, iperf3, iostat, blktrace)


**About Together AI**



Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose\-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high\-performance inference that scales reliably, fine\-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier\-level specialized models, and pre\-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400\+ trillion tokens a month.


**Equal Opportunity**



Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more.



Please see our privacy policy at https://www.together.ai/privacy

They identify repetitive operational processes, design intelligent automation to eliminate them, and actively evaluate how emerging AI capabilities can be embedded into IT workflows.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of traditional infrastructure ownership and AI\-enabled operations. You will own the reliability and security of our hybrid cloud environment while driving measurable reductions in manual IT workload through automation and intelligent system integration.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Cloud infrastructure and system administration**
* Administer macOS, Windows 10/11, and Windows Server environments with a focus on reducing manual administration through intelligent tooling.
* Manage Azure AD / Entra ID, Conditional Access policies, and Azure AD Domain Services, including Group Policy, authentication, and access control.
* Administer Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams) and endpoint management platforms (Intune).
* Support Azure cloud infrastructure, hybrid connectivity, and platform\-as\-a\-service workloads.


**Networking and security**
* Support and troubleshoot hybrid networking infrastructure, including VPNs, firewalls, DNS, DHCP, and VLANs.
* Collaborate with the security team to maintain HIPAA, HITRUST, and NIST compliance across all managed systems.
* Implement and monitor EDR/XDR solutions and integrate security telemetry into automated alerting and response workflows.


**Monitoring and reliability**
* Build and maintain automated monitoring pipelines that surface anomalies before they escalate, reducing mean time to detection.
* Develop self\-healing runbooks and AI\-assisted incident response workflows to reduce escalation volume and on\-call burden.
* Document all automation, integrations, and infrastructure changes in a centralized, version\-controlled knowledge base.


**AI integration and intelligent automation**
* Design and deploy AI\-powered automation workflows that replace repetitive IT processes — including ticket triage, access provisioning, patch scheduling, and system health alerting.
* Implement and manage MCP\-based integrations that allow AI agents and internal tools to interact with IT infrastructure components, identity systems, and cloud services.
* Evaluate, pilot, and operationalize large language model (LLM)\-driven tools for IT operations — including AI\-assisted scripting, anomaly detection, and runbook generation.
* Partner with engineering and product teams to ensure AI infrastructure integrations meet security, compliance, and audit requirements.


**API and systems integration**
* Build and maintain REST and GraphQL API integrations that connect Microsoft 365, Azure, endpoint management tools, and third\-party IT platforms.
* Design integration architectures using MCP servers to expose IT system capabilities to AI agents and internal automation pipelines.
* Develop and maintain automation libraries in Python and PowerShell, moving beyond one\-off scripts toward reusable, version\-controlled infrastructure\-as\-code.
* Manage identity and access workflows through API\-driven automation across Azure AD / Entra ID, and Intune.


**Collaboration and IT support**
* Provide Tier 3 support for escalated infrastructure issues, applying automation tooling to accelerate resolution.
* Work directly with DevOps, security, and software engineering teams to align IT infrastructure investments with product and platform roadmaps.
* Participate in disaster recovery planning and business continuity design, with an emphasis on automating failover and recovery procedures.


**Required**
**Qualifications and experience**
* 5\+ years of experience in systems engineering or systems administration demonstrated ownership of complex hybrid cloud environments.
* Hands\-on experience implementing AI tools or LLM\-powered workflows in an IT operations context — including prompt engineering, API integration, or agent orchestration.
* Working knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP): how MCP servers are structured, how AI agents consume tool definitions, and how to expose IT system capabilities through MCP endpoints.
* Strong API fluency: experience building and maintaining REST API integrations using Python, PowerShell, or equivalent, with version control and documentation practices.
* Proficiency in Microsoft 365, Azure AD / Entra ID, and Azure cloud services.
* Experience with endpoint management platforms (Intune).
* Networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, VLANs, and firewall management.
* Demonstrated experience in a healthcare IT or regulated environment (HIPAA, HITRUST, NIST).


**Preferred**
* Experience building AI agent workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, AutoGen, or custom MCP server implementations.
* Familiarity with infrastructure\-as\-code and GitOps practices (Terraform, Bicep, or equivalent).
* Background in DevOps or platform engineering, with exposure to CI/CD pipelines and containerized workloads.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, MCSE, or equivalent certification.

description:
**About Giggso** 




  






 At Giggso, we bridge the gap between high\-level AI strategy and enterprise\-grade execution. We build context\-aware, secure enterprise AI engineering platforms across core Business Operations (Sales, Support, RevOps) and AI Security Operations.
 




  






 Moving far beyond basic RAG and static prompts, Giggso builds foundational Data \& Knowledge Layers—turning raw unstructured data and enterprise ontologies into trustworthy, audit\-ready AI agents. From multi\-modal agentic architectures to proactive AI red teaming and security guardrails, Giggso ensures enterprise AI operates reliably at scale.
 




  





**Role Overview:** 




  






 We are seeking a visionary and hands\-on Director of AI/ML Architecture to lead Giggso’s overall AI technical strategy, system architecture, and machine learning governance. In this executive\-track role, you will bridge executive leadership and engineering execution—setting the strategic blueprint for Giggso’s AI platforms, driving architectural standards, and advancing innovations in multi\-agent orchestration, Knowledge Graphs, and AI Security Operations.
 




  






 If you are driven by passion and innovation, determined to bend the limits, and hungry to build something truly transformative that leaves a mark—this role is for you.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Executive Technical Leadership \& AI Strategy** 




  




* Define and drive the multi\-year AI/ML technical roadmap, aligning platform architecture with long\-term business goals, cloud unit economics, and client adoption strategies.
* Partner with executive leadership to evaluate emerging AI paradigms, steer technical investments, and serve as the primary technical authority in high\-stakes enterprise client engagements.
* Architect scalable, resilient, and secure AI systems operating across multi\-cloud and hybrid environments for both real\-time and batch\-processing workloads.



  





**2\. Enterprise Platform Architecture \& Agentic Systems** 




  




* System Design: Spearhead the architectural blueprint for Giggso’s core platform capabilities—advanced Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG), Knowledge Graph ontologies, multi\-agent frameworks, and model fine\-tuning pipelines.
* Optimization \& Efficiency: Establish enterprise design patterns for low\-latency inference, dynamic prompt caching, model serving, and token cost optimization across high\-throughput workloads.
* Technical Prototyping: Remain hands\-on through architectural spike execution, technical design reviews, and high\-impact code reviews for core framework modules.


- 


**3\. AI Security, Governance \& MLOps Strategy** 




  




* Responsible AI \& Security: Champion AI safety, data privacy, model governance, and compliance frameworks (SOC2, GDPR, ISO 42001\) while building active defenses against prompt injection, jailbreaking, and data leakage.
* Enterprise MLOps: Standardize the end\-to\-end MLOps lifecycle—implementing automated continuous evaluation (Evals), prompt versioning, model registries, drift detection, and automated failover systems.



  





**4\. Team Building \& Engineering Excellence** 




  




* Mentor, manage, and elevate AI/ML Tech Leads, Principal Architects, and Senior Engineers across global pods.
* Foster a high\-rigor engineering culture focused on rapid iteration, research\-backed development, security and production reliability.



  





**Required Qualifications** 




  





**Leadership \& Strategic Experience** 




  




* Total Experience: 15\+ years of progressive software engineering and system architecture experience.
* Leadership Track Record: 5\+ years in a senior architectural leadership role (Principal Architect, Staff/Distinguished Engineer, or Director of AI/ML) delivering production\-grade AI systems at scale.
* Commercial Acumen: Proven ability to manage cloud compute budgets, optimize model inference unit economics, and present technical vision to C\-suite stakeholders.



  





**Deep Technical Expertise** 




  




* Core Languages \& Frameworks: Expert proficiency in Python (FastAPI, PyDantic, PyTorch) and enterprise cloud stacks (AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, GCP Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI).
* Agentic Workflows \& Knowledge Graphs: Direct architectural experience with multi\-agent orchestration (LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, LangChain), vector databases (Qdrant, Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate), and Knowledge Graphs (Neo4j, RDF/OWL, Ontologies).
* AI Security \& Governance: Deep understanding of guardrail implementation, adversarial prompt testing, red\-teaming paradigms, and model evaluation protocols (e.g., RAGAS, TruLens).
* Infrastructure \& Systems Design: Proven mastery of microservices, event\-driven architectures, Kubernetes, Docker, and enterprise MLOps CI/CD pipelines.



  





**Education \& Credentials** 




  




* Education: Master’s, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience demonstrated through industry accomplishments).
* Certifications (Preferred): Professional cloud or AI certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Machine Learning Specialty, GCP Professional ML Engineer, Azure AI Engineer) or executive AI program credentials from leading institutions.



  





**Why Join Giggso?** 




  




* Shape the Frontier: Architect next\-generation Knowledge Graph and Agentic AI stacks that solve fundamental enterprise challenges.
* Executive Impact: Direct visibility with C\-suite leadership and freedom to define technical strategy across the enterprise.
* Culture of Innovation: Lead a high\-performing engineering organization building trustworthy, audit\-ready AI infrastructure.

With a proven track record across diverse industries, the team focuses on proactive protection of digital assets through tailored, cutting‑edge security solutions. Clear InfoSec is a Minority and Women Owned business, offering an inclusive and innovative environment for security professionals.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Network Security Architect role is a full\-time remote position responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining secure network and security architectures for client environments. In this role, you will assess existing infrastructures, identify vulnerabilities, and develop robust security designs, including segmentation, secure connectivity, and resilience strategies. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define security requirements, select appropriate technologies, and ensure that network solutions align with cybersecurity best practices and regulatory standards. Daily activities include producing architecture documentation and diagrams, reviewing configurations and change requests, performing threat and risk analyses, and providing guidance on secure design patterns. title: Solutions Architect
description:
MongoDB is seeking a Partner Solutions Architect to focus on our Large Deals exclusively on strategic, high\-value pursuits with Global System Integrators (GSIs). This role will lead the technical strategy and execution of complex GSI\-led bids, helping MongoDB and its GSI partners develop differentiated solutions and secure large, strategic opportunities.
   

  

 The successful candidate will operate across MongoDB, GSI partners, customers, sales teams, delivery organizations, and executive stakeholders to develop compelling joint solutions, strengthen technical win strategies, and drive successful outcomes for large transformation programs.
   

  

 We are looking for candidates who are based in Bengaluru/Gurugram/Delhi/Hyderabad/Chennai for our hybrid working model.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead the technical architecture and solution strategy for large, complex, and strategic bids
* Partner with sales, bid leadership, account teams, product specialists, services, legal, finance, and executive sponsors to deliver coordinated pursuits
* Develop joint value propositions, solution architectures, technical proposals, statements of work, and bid responses
* Engage partner architects and delivery teams to validate feasibility, implementation approach, scope, risks, and dependencies
* Facilitate technical discovery, architecture workshops, solution reviews, demonstrations, proof\-of\-value activities, and executive presentations
* Translate customer business outcomes into scalable MongoDB\-based architectures and partner delivery models
* Shape partner\-led modernization, migration, cloud, application development, data, analytics, and AI solutions
* Identify technical risks, competitive threats, delivery constraints, and commercial considerations early in the bid lifecycle
* Create reusable bid assets, reference architectures, technical content, and best practices for future pursuits
* Ensure proposed solutions align with MongoDB product capabilities, partner expertise, security requirements, and customer success criteria
* Support deal qualification, opportunity prioritization, account planning, and pipeline\-generation activities
* Coordinate technical responses across multiple partners and ensure consistency in messaging, assumptions, and commitments
* Mentor field Solutions Architects and partner technical teams on large\-bid strategy and execution
* Capture field feedback and communicate product, capability, and partner requirements to internal teams


**Required Qualifications**
* Experience in a customer\-facing Solutions Architect, Partner Solutions Architect, Presales Architect, Consulting Architect, or equivalent role
* Experience supporting complex enterprise bids, tenders, RFPs, or strategic pursuits
* Proven ability to design and communicate distributed, scalable, secure, and highly available architectures
* Experience working with Global System Integrators (GSIs), including GSI sales, consulting, architecture, and delivery teams
* Strong understanding of cloud platforms, modern application architectures, microservices, APIs, data platforms, and DevOps
* Experience developing technical proposals, solution designs, presentations, and executive\-level bid content
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders, work under tight deadlines, and drive outcomes in ambiguous situations
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and negotiation skills
* Ability to explain complex technical and business concepts clearly to technical and executive audiences
* Willingness to travel as required for customer and partner engagements
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with MongoDB, Atlas, relational database modernization, or NoSQL technologies
* MongoDB certification or certification with a major cloud provider
* Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud
* Experience in large\-scale transformation, legacy modernization, data modernization, AI/ML, or application development programs
* Familiarity with enterprise sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC or Command of the Message
* Experience working with public\-sector or regulated\-industry procurement processes
* Experience developing joint go\-to\-market propositions and partner delivery models
* Experience leading technical workstreams in multi\-year, multi\-million\-dollar pursuits


**About MongoDB**
 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud\-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi\-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
   

  

 With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI\-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
   

  

 Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
   

  

 To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
   

  

 MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

 serve as dynamic innovation and operations hubs, designed to expand McDonald's global talent base and in\-house expertise.  Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Data Engineer, Python, Java, Gradle, Maven, Terraform, New Relic, OpenTelemetry, DevOps, CI/CD, Kubernetes, Docker, Cloud Run, ECS, GCP, AWS, Confluent, Kafka, mParticle, Braze, streaming data

 We are seeking an experienced Sr. Data Engineer / Technical Lead to provide Engineering delivery \& architectural leadership for McDonald’s Marketer Customer Data Platform (mCDP). This role is responsible for defining and evolving the technical architecture of backend systems that ingest, process, and distribute high volumes of customer data in both real\-time and batch environments, thus supporting critical customer engagement initiatives and key revenue drivers.
 



 As a Technical Lead, you will act as a primary source of technical authority for the team, partnering closely with the Product Owner, enterprise and solution architects, and peer product teams. You will ensure that business requirements are translated into scalable, secure, and resilient technical solutions, while guiding engineers in implementation and best practices.

* Product \& Cross\-Team Collaboration

* Ensure observability, reliability, and operational readiness are built into solutions from design through production.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to senior, mid\-level, and junior engineers.

* Proficiency with build and dependency management tools such as Maven and/or Gradle.
* Deep expertise in cloud\-native architectures on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Deep, hands\-on experience with event\-driven architectures and streaming platforms (e.g., Kafka, Confluent, Pub/Sub).

* Expert knowledge of, and experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure\-as\-code, and modern DevOps practices.

title: Forward Deployed Engineering Leader- Microsoft AI Business Solutions
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
 At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
   

  

**Job Description:**
 Crowe's Microsoft focused delivery practice brings together advisory, outcome delivery and managed services across Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure, data, automation and AI. The practice is expected to double over the next two years, and this role will help shape how our approximately 20 person India engineering team operates as it grows.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced engineering leader who has built strong teams, raised technical standards and improved how complex software is delivered. Deep experience with every Microsoft product is not required. What matters most is engineering judgment, people leadership, learning agility and the ability to work with platform specialists to make sound architecture and delivery decisions.
   

  

 This is a player coach role. You will remain technically engaged through architecture reviews, critical design decisions, prototypes, complex delivery situations and customer conversations. You will not be expected to be the deepest specialist in every Microsoft technology, but you must be able to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions and help teams reach practical, defensible decisions.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Build a high performing engineering organization with clear expectations for quality, ownership, collaboration, technical judgment and continuous improvement.
* Set and evolve engineering and architecture standards across applications, data, cloud, automation, AI, security and integration, partnering with Dynamics 365, Power Platform and Azure specialists where deep platform expertise is needed.
* Stay close to the work by reviewing critical designs, contributing to prototypes and accelerators, helping resolve complex delivery issues and participating in important client conversations.
* Translate ambiguous business problems into practical solution approaches, including deciding when AI or an agentic workflow is appropriate and when better data, a clearer process or a deterministic solution will serve the client better.
* Coach engineers, technical leads and architects; identify high potential talent; strengthen succession; influence performance decisions; and make difficult talent calls when needed.
* Improve the team's ability to work directly with business users, IT teams, architects and senior leaders, particularly when requirements are incomplete or business processes need to change.
* Help expand the practice across Power Platform, Azure, data, automation, Copilot and agentic AI by creating an environment in which specialists can learn from one another and apply strong engineering fundamentals consistently.


**What You Will Do, Continued**
* Identify opportunities to automate delivery, reuse components and create Crowe intellectual property that reduces effort, improves quality and increases margin across multiple engagements.
* Establish meaningful measures for throughput, cycle time, predictability, rework, defects, escalations, reuse and team health, then drive visible improvement against them.
* Support solution shaping, estimation, technical workshops, pre sales and executive discussions, connecting technical choices to client outcomes, delivery risk and commercial value.
* Partner with practice leadership to turn repeatable delivery patterns into fixed fee or managed services offerings with clear scope, architecture, delivery playbooks and operating measures.


**What Success Looks Like**
**Within your first year, you will have:**
* Raised the engineering bar. Teams are operating with clearer standards, stronger architecture discipline and greater ownership of difficult decisions.
* Strengthened the leadership bench. Technical leads and high potential engineers are visibly more capable, and expectations and performance decisions are clearer.
* Improved delivery health. Predictability, cycle time, quality, escalations and rework are measured, understood and moving in the right direction.
* Put reuse to work. Components, delivery patterns, automation and AI enabled workflows are being applied across multiple engagements rather than remaining isolated within one project.
* Built credibility across the Microsoft practice. Platform specialists see you as a leader who improves their decisions and effectiveness, even when they have deeper product expertise.
* Earned client trust. Clients and colleagues involve you in ambiguous, high consequence technical and delivery decisions.
* Opened a stronger commercial path. The practice has a growing pipeline of repeatable fixed fee or managed services offerings supported by real delivery playbooks.
* Developed practical fluency across Crowe's Microsoft portfolio and a clear understanding of where specialist depth is required.


**Required Experience**
* Ten or more years of software engineering experience, including at least five years leading engineering teams in a global or distributed environment.
* A demonstrated record of building high performing teams, developing leaders, mentoring engineers and improving engineering culture and delivery outcomes.
* Strong technical foundations across modern application architecture, cloud platforms, APIs, integrations, data, security, automation and software delivery practices.


**Required Experience, Continued**
* Experience setting technical standards and leading architecture or design decisions across complex products, platforms or client engagements.
* Sufficient hands on depth to review designs, challenge technical assumptions, guide prototypes and lead teams through difficult engineering problems.
* Experience with AI enabled software, automation or data driven solutions, including the judgment to evaluate whether AI is appropriate for a business problem.
* Strong client and executive communication skills, with the ability to translate between business outcomes, engineering tradeoffs and delivery risk.
* Experience leading through a meaningful business or engineering transformation that changed how work was performed, not simply which system was used.
* Comfort operating with ambiguity, taking ownership and making progress before every detail is known.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience with one or more parts of the Microsoft business applications and cloud ecosystem, such as Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Dataverse, Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI or Azure AI Search.
* Experience in consulting or professional services, including scoped client engagements, solution shaping, estimation and technical workshops.
* Experience leading production AI enabled or agentic solutions with appropriate evaluation, security, governance and human oversight.
* Exposure to fixed fee delivery, managed services, reusable intellectual property or other approaches that improve delivery leverage and margin.
* Business process experience in areas such as customer service, sales, field service, finance, operations, risk or compliance.


**How We Will Support Your Success**
 You will work closely with experienced Dynamics 365, Power Platform and Azure practitioners who provide deep product expertise. In turn, you will help those specialists apply stronger engineering methods, architecture discipline, people leadership and delivery practices. We expect you to build practical Microsoft fluency quickly, while being candid about where specialist input is needed.
   

  

**Mindset we value**
* You make other engineers and leaders better, remain technically engaged and do not need to be the expert in every room.
* You automate unnecessary work, communicate clearly, seek evidence, invite challenge and own outcomes across people, technology, delivery and clients.


**What It Means To Be a Consultant At Crowe**
 Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.
   

  

 In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high\-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.
   

  

 Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.
   

  

 Beyond that, we're looking for someone who:
   

  

* Has an automation mindset — the instinct is to eliminate the work, not just scale the number of people doing it.
* Communicates just as well in front of an engineering team as in front of a client's leadership, without needing two different vocabularies to do it.
* Takes ownership without waiting for permission and is willing to move before the path is fully clear.
* Has led through a real business transformation before — a change in how work actually gets done, not just a system migration.


 We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.
   

  

**Our Benefits:**
 At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!
   

  

**How You Can Grow:**
 We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!
   

  

**More about Crowe:**
 Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.
   

  

 Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third\-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre\-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.
   

  

 We are committed to a merit\-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job\-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

**Technical Leadership and Architecture**

**Mentoring and Capability Building**
* Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, debugging sessions, and structured knowledge\-sharing discussions.
* Help junior and mid\-level engineers improve estimation, problem decomposition, coding standards, testing habits, and ownership mindset.
* Encourage reuse of common components, shared engineering practices, and consistent documentation across the team.
* Provide timely, constructive technical feedback to help team members improve delivery quality and engineering maturity.
* Identify skill gaps and recommend learning opportunities related to .NET, AWS cloud services, integrations, security, performance, and AI\-enabled product capabilities.


**Project Ownership and Delivery Accountability**
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of assigned initiatives, features, or technical workstreams from requirements clarification through design, build, testing, release, and post\-release support.
* Ensure scope, dependencies, assumptions, risks, and acceptance criteria are understood before implementation starts.
* Coordinate with QA, DevOps, Support, Product Management, Architecture, Security, and dependent engineering teams to ensure smooth delivery.
* Track commitments, communicate progress periodically, and ensure stakeholders have visibility into status, risks, and mitigation plans.
* Support release readiness activities, including build validation, deployment checks, defect triage, production monitoring, and rollback or recovery planning where applicable.
* Drive root\-cause analysis for recurring defects or production issues and convert findings into preventive engineering improvements.


**Stakeholder Management and Communication**
* Engage with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, support teams, and cross\-functional engineering teams to clarify requirements and align on implementation approach.
* Communicate technical decisions, risks, trade\-offs, and delivery status clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Represent the engineering team in design discussions, sprint ceremonies, release discussions, issue triage, and customer\-impact analysis as required.
* Escalate deviations from specifications, design assumptions, UI mockups, timelines, or quality expectations with proposed resolution options.
* Ensure team documentation, design notes, release notes, and support handover information are accurate and maintained.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Hands\-on Microsoft .NET development experience, including C\#, ASP.NET, .NET Core, Web API, web services, and related frameworks.
* Experience with SQL Server, XML standards, JavaScript/JQuery, API integration, and service\-based application development.
* Good understanding of design patterns, SOLID principles, clean code practices, and maintainable application architecture.
* Experience with Git\-based configuration management and modern development workflows.
* Good understanding of AWS cloud technologies such as Lambda, Step Functions, SQS, Textract, Bedrock, and related cloud services.
* Experience with microservices architecture, event\-driven systems, distributed processing, performance optimization, scalability, and observability.
* Good understanding of Python and machine learning concepts is preferred.
* Good to have experience with Generative AI technologies, including frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Hugging Face, and integration of AI/ML models into software applications.
* Knowledge of ERP systems, document processing, system integrations, and business workflows is preferred.


**Preferred Qualifications**
**Leadership Expectations**
* Ownership mindset: Takes accountability for outcomes, not just assigned tasks, and follows through until issues are resolved.
* Execution discipline: Balances technical quality with delivery timelines and keeps the team focused on priorities.
* Decision quality: Makes practical engineering decisions using data, technical judgment, and stakeholder context.
* Coaching orientation: Invests time in mentoring team members and raising overall team capability.
* Collaboration: Works effectively across functions, locations, and release cycles while maintaining transparency.
* Operational readiness: Ensures features are supportable, observable, secure, scalable, and production\-ready.
* Continuous improvement: Identifies recurring problems and drives improvements in process, architecture, automation, and engineering practices.


**To Be Successful You Need**
* Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum of 4 years of software development experience, with demonstrated ability to lead feature areas or technical workstreams.
* Strong hands\-on technical capability with Microsoft .NET, cloud services, APIs, integrations, and modern engineering practices.
* Good communication skills and ability to work with multiple teams, geographies, and stakeholder groups.
* Proven ability to mentor engineers, review designs, guide implementation, and improve technical quality.
* Good team player with a collaborative approach and willingness to support team members during critical delivery or production issues.
* Ability to manage ambiguity, clarify requirements, break down complex work, and drive execution in agile environments.
* Strong customer and product mindset, with focus on quality, maintainability, performance, security, and supportability.


**Success Measures**
* Feature work is delivered with clear ownership, predictable execution, and minimal avoidable rework.
* Code quality, test coverage, documentation, observability, and support readiness improve across assigned areas.
* Team members receive timely guidance, blockers are addressed quickly, and engineering practices become more consistent.

 Leadership \& Business Skills

 A

The **Senior Network Architect** is a highly skilled subject matter expert responsible for designing, architecting, and leading complex and strategic network initiatives.


This role involves setting network technology standards, driving innovation, and providing technical leadership in network infrastructure design and implementation.


The Senior Network Architect plays a pivotal role in shaping network strategies and ensuring alignment with overall business objectives.


**Location:** Pune, India – Remote
  

**Experience:** 15–18\+ Years
  

**Certification:** **CCIE – Mandatory**
