* Lead the design and architecture of advanced network solutions, including **LAN, WAN, Data Center, Cloud, and Hybrid Cloud environments** .
* Develop highly scalable, secure, resilient, and high\-performing network architectures to meet current and future business requirements.
* Define and establish network technology standards, best practices, architecture principles, and technology roadmaps.
* Evaluate new networking technologies and recommend their adoption based on business and technical requirements.
* Contribute to strategic network initiatives that align with the company's long\-term technology and business goals.
* Introduce innovative solutions and approaches to enhance network performance, security, availability, scalability, and operational efficiency.
* Lead and manage network projects from inception through completion.

* Establish and maintain strong relationships with network vendors, service providers, cloud providers, and technology partners.

* Stay current with emerging networking technologies, industry trends, and technology developments and assess their applicability to the organization.
* Develop and maintain high\-level network documentation, including architecture diagrams, HLD/LLD documents, configuration templates, standards, and technical guidelines.
* Perform network capacity planning to accommodate anticipated business growth and evolving technology requirements.
* Provide architectural guidance and technical leadership for network transformation, modernization, migration, and optimization initiatives.
* Lead architecture reviews and ensure network designs comply with established enterprise standards, security requirements, and best practices.

* Extensive hands\-on experience with network monitoring, analysis, troubleshooting, and performance management tools.
* Excellent documentation, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Extensive proficiency in network administration, configuration, and architecture tools.
* Proven experience leading and managing large\-scale network architecture, transformation, and migration projects.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex network issues.
* Strong ability to translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and resilient network architectures.
* Strong ability to align network strategies and technology roadmaps with business objectives.
Ability to work effectively with global teams, senior leadership, vendors, service providers, and cross\-functional stakeholders.  
*

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in **Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field** .

* **Minimum 15–18\+ years of experience in the Network and Security domain.**
* Extensive experience in network engineering, architecture, and progressively responsible technical leadership roles.
* Extensive experience working in large\-scale enterprise networking environments.
* Extensive experience designing and architecting complex **LAN and WAN** environments.

* Extensive experience with **Data Center networking and connectivity** .

title: Data Modeler
description:
Data Modeler

**About the Role**


As a **Data Modeler at TVH**, you will play a central role in shaping how our global organization structures, understands, and leverages its data. Operating across **all core business domains** (e.g., Customer, Supplier, Item, Product, Equipment, HR, Finance, Commercial, Operations, …), you will design, develop, and maintain high\-performing Logical Data Models (LDM) and Physical Data Models (PDM) that power enterprise reporting, analytics, and operational applications.


You will translate diverse cross\-domain business requirements into clear, standardized, and scalable data structures. Working closely with Domain Architects, Data Engineers, and Data Stewards, you will ensure our logical abstractions align perfectly with business reality while our physical implementations maximize database performance and data accessibility.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Enterprise Logical \& Physical Data Model Design:**
	+ Design, construct, and maintain normalized Conceptual and **Logical Data Models (LDM)** across all enterprise domains, establishing clear entities, attributes, relationships, and business definitions.
	+ Translate LDMs into optimized **Physical Data Models (PDM)** tailored for target database platforms, balancing storage efficiency, index strategies, and query performance.
	+ Reverse\-engineer legacy source systems and translate complex domain requirements into normalized, reusable data structures.
	+ Produce and manage comprehensive data documentation, including ERDs (Entity\-Relationship Diagrams), data dictionaries, and data mapping lineage.
* **Domain Alignment \& Standards Governance:**
	+ Drive consistent data modeling standards, naming conventions, and design patterns across all domain modeling initiatives.
	+ Partner with Data Governance teams to incorporate standardized business glossaries and enterprise metadata standards directly into model structures.
	+ Conduct data model reviews with technical and business teams to ensure cross\-domain consistency and avoid data duplication.
* **Cross\-Functional Technical Collaboration:**
	+ Work hand\-in\-hand with Domain Architects to ensure domain models fit seamlessly into TVH’s target data architecture strategy.
	+ Collaborate with Data Engineers to guide the physical realization of models and support optimized ETL/ELT pipeline design.
	+ Partner with Data Analysts, Data Stewards and Business Partners to validate logical assumptions, clarify business logic, and refine domain models as needs evolve.
* **Model Optimization \& Quality:**
	+ Profile source data using SQL to uncover structural edge cases and validate cardinality before finalizing logical designs.
	+ Refine physical schemas for cloud data warehouses, adjusting partitioning, clustering, and denormalization strategies to meet performance SLAs.

**Qualifications**

* **5\+ years of hands\-on experience** focused specifically on Logical Data Modeling (LDM) and Physical Data Modeling (PDM) across multiple business domains.
* Deep expertise in diverse modeling paradigms: Relational/Entity\-Relationship (3NF), Dimensional Modeling (Star/Snowflake), and Denormalization concepts.
* Strong proficiency in **SQL** for deep source system profiling, data mapping, and schema validation.
* Hands\-on experience with modern **cloud data warehouses** (preferably **GCP BigQuery**, Snowflake, or Databricks) and relational database platforms.
* Proficiency with enterprise data modeling tools (e.g., Erwin, PowerDesigner, SqlDBM, or similar).
* Solid understanding of Data Warehousing principles, metadata management, and ETL/ELT architecture.
* Fluent in English with excellent communication skills to articulate complex logical structures to both business stakeholders and engineering teams.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with **Data Vault 2\.0** modeling methodologies for enterprise scale.
* Exposure to real\-time or streaming data modeling patterns (Event\-driven architectures).
* Understanding of data privacy impact on data design (e.g., handling PII attributes across global domains).
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum distributed software delivery teams.

**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU**


You’ll be part of a people\-centric culture, where your well\-being matters. Our comprehensive package offers standard benefits such as medical, dental, and vision, plus unique benefits such as our onsite health clinic and our incredible dollar for dollar 401(k) match up to 6%. At our HQ, there’s an on\-site preschool, restaurant and where you can get active or enjoy our regular team get\-togethers.

**PEOPLE ARE AT OUR HEART**


TVH is a global business with a family atmosphere, where people are at the center. We value clarity, mutual respect, kindness and open communication. Our people are down\-to\-earth, easy to work and engage with. We welcome differences and celebrate new ideas.


**ABOUT TVH**


TVH is a parts specialist for quality parts and accessories for material handling, industrial vehicles, and construction and agricultural equipment. Working at TVH is opting for a company that excels as an international market leader and is well\-known for its unstoppable craving for innovation.

**Job Description: Job Summary**

**We are seeking an experienced Data Steward with 10\+ years of experience in data governance, data quality, metadata management, and regulatory compliance. The ideal candidate will act as a bridge between business and technology teams to ensure data is accurate, consistent, secure, and aligned with enterprise data governance standards. The role requires strong stakeholder management, data management expertise, and experience implementing data governance frameworks across large organizations.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Data Governance \& Stewardship**

* **Define, implement, and enforce enterprise data governance policies, standards, and procedures.**
* **Act as the owner and custodian of critical business data domains.**
* **Establish data stewardship processes and operating models across business functions.**
* **Collaborate with Data Owners, Data Custodians, and business stakeholders to improve data management practices.**

**Data Quality Management**

* **Monitor, measure, and improve data quality using predefined KPIs and metrics.**
* **Identify data quality issues, perform root cause analysis, and drive remediation efforts.**
* **Define data quality rules, controls, and validation mechanisms.**
* **Implement continuous monitoring processes for critical data assets.**

* **Promote adoption of data catalog platforms across business teams.**

* **Drive awareness and training programs related to data governance and stewardship.**

title: Manager Data Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
**Manager – Data Engineering**
 Publicis Sapient is seeking a Manager – Data Engineering to join our high\-performing engineering team. In this role, you will lead the design and delivery of scalable, cloud native data engineering solutions, partnering with clients and cross\-functional teams to solve complex business challenges. You will provide technical leadership, drive architecture decisions, mentor engineering teams, and ensure the successful implementation of modern data platforms that power analytics, AI, and digital transformation initiatives. As a Manager, you will combine deep technical expertise in big data and cloud technologies with strong consulting, stakeholder management, and people leadership capabilities to enable clients to unlock value from enterprise\-scale data ecosystems.
   

  

**Your Impact:**
* Lead the design, architecture, and delivery of large\-scale data engineering solutions across cloud and hybrid environments.

title: Forward Deployed Engineering Leader- Microsoft AI Business Solutions
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
 At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
   

  

**Job Description:**
 Crowe's Microsoft focused delivery practice brings together advisory, outcome delivery and managed services across Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure, data, automation and AI. The practice is expected to double over the next two years, and this role will help shape how our approximately 20 person India engineering team operates as it grows.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced engineering leader who has built strong teams, raised technical standards and improved how complex software is delivered. Deep experience with every Microsoft product is not required. What matters most is engineering judgment, people leadership, learning agility and the ability to work with platform specialists to make sound architecture and delivery decisions.
   

  

 This is a player coach role. You will remain technically engaged through architecture reviews, critical design decisions, prototypes, complex delivery situations and customer conversations. You will not be expected to be the deepest specialist in every Microsoft technology, but you must be able to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions and help teams reach practical, defensible decisions.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Build a high performing engineering organization with clear expectations for quality, ownership, collaboration, technical judgment and continuous improvement.
* Set and evolve engineering and architecture standards across applications, data, cloud, automation, AI, security and integration, partnering with Dynamics 365, Power Platform and Azure specialists where deep platform expertise is needed.
* Stay close to the work by reviewing critical designs, contributing to prototypes and accelerators, helping resolve complex delivery issues and participating in important client conversations.
* Translate ambiguous business problems into practical solution approaches, including deciding when AI or an agentic workflow is appropriate and when better data, a clearer process or a deterministic solution will serve the client better.
* Coach engineers, technical leads and architects; identify high potential talent; strengthen succession; influence performance decisions; and make difficult talent calls when needed.
* Improve the team's ability to work directly with business users, IT teams, architects and senior leaders, particularly when requirements are incomplete or business processes need to change.
* Help expand the practice across Power Platform, Azure, data, automation, Copilot and agentic AI by creating an environment in which specialists can learn from one another and apply strong engineering fundamentals consistently.


**What You Will Do, Continued**
* Identify opportunities to automate delivery, reuse components and create Crowe intellectual property that reduces effort, improves quality and increases margin across multiple engagements.
* Establish meaningful measures for throughput, cycle time, predictability, rework, defects, escalations, reuse and team health, then drive visible improvement against them.
* Support solution shaping, estimation, technical workshops, pre sales and executive discussions, connecting technical choices to client outcomes, delivery risk and commercial value.
* Partner with practice leadership to turn repeatable delivery patterns into fixed fee or managed services offerings with clear scope, architecture, delivery playbooks and operating measures.


**What Success Looks Like**
**Within your first year, you will have:**
* Raised the engineering bar. Teams are operating with clearer standards, stronger architecture discipline and greater ownership of difficult decisions.
* Strengthened the leadership bench. Technical leads and high potential engineers are visibly more capable, and expectations and performance decisions are clearer.
* Improved delivery health. Predictability, cycle time, quality, escalations and rework are measured, understood and moving in the right direction.
* Put reuse to work. Components, delivery patterns, automation and AI enabled workflows are being applied across multiple engagements rather than remaining isolated within one project.
* Built credibility across the Microsoft practice. Platform specialists see you as a leader who improves their decisions and effectiveness, even when they have deeper product expertise.
* Earned client trust. Clients and colleagues involve you in ambiguous, high consequence technical and delivery decisions.
* Opened a stronger commercial path. The practice has a growing pipeline of repeatable fixed fee or managed services offerings supported by real delivery playbooks.
* Developed practical fluency across Crowe's Microsoft portfolio and a clear understanding of where specialist depth is required.


**Required Experience**
* Ten or more years of software engineering experience, including at least five years leading engineering teams in a global or distributed environment.
* A demonstrated record of building high performing teams, developing leaders, mentoring engineers and improving engineering culture and delivery outcomes.
* Strong technical foundations across modern application architecture, cloud platforms, APIs, integrations, data, security, automation and software delivery practices.


**Required Experience, Continued**
* Experience setting technical standards and leading architecture or design decisions across complex products, platforms or client engagements.
* Sufficient hands on depth to review designs, challenge technical assumptions, guide prototypes and lead teams through difficult engineering problems.
* Experience with AI enabled software, automation or data driven solutions, including the judgment to evaluate whether AI is appropriate for a business problem.
* Strong client and executive communication skills, with the ability to translate between business outcomes, engineering tradeoffs and delivery risk.
* Experience leading through a meaningful business or engineering transformation that changed how work was performed, not simply which system was used.
* Comfort operating with ambiguity, taking ownership and making progress before every detail is known.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience with one or more parts of the Microsoft business applications and cloud ecosystem, such as Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Dataverse, Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI or Azure AI Search.
* Experience in consulting or professional services, including scoped client engagements, solution shaping, estimation and technical workshops.
* Experience leading production AI enabled or agentic solutions with appropriate evaluation, security, governance and human oversight.
* Exposure to fixed fee delivery, managed services, reusable intellectual property or other approaches that improve delivery leverage and margin.
* Business process experience in areas such as customer service, sales, field service, finance, operations, risk or compliance.


**How We Will Support Your Success**
 You will work closely with experienced Dynamics 365, Power Platform and Azure practitioners who provide deep product expertise. In turn, you will help those specialists apply stronger engineering methods, architecture discipline, people leadership and delivery practices. We expect you to build practical Microsoft fluency quickly, while being candid about where specialist input is needed.
   

  

**Mindset we value**
* You make other engineers and leaders better, remain technically engaged and do not need to be the expert in every room.
* You automate unnecessary work, communicate clearly, seek evidence, invite challenge and own outcomes across people, technology, delivery and clients.


**What It Means To Be a Consultant At Crowe**
 Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.
   

  

 In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high\-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.
   

  

 Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.
   

  

 Beyond that, we're looking for someone who:
   

  

* Has an automation mindset — the instinct is to eliminate the work, not just scale the number of people doing it.
* Communicates just as well in front of an engineering team as in front of a client's leadership, without needing two different vocabularies to do it.
* Takes ownership without waiting for permission and is willing to move before the path is fully clear.
* Has led through a real business transformation before — a change in how work actually gets done, not just a system migration.


 We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.
   

  

**Our Benefits:**
 At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!
   

  

**How You Can Grow:**
 We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!
   

  

**More about Crowe:**
 Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.
   

  

 Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third\-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre\-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.
   

  

 We are committed to a merit\-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job\-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

title: Director, Software Development Engineering
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
   

  

 Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
   

  

**Introduction To Team**
 As Director, you will lead the engineering organization responsible for Reservations across two of Expedia Group's largest lines of business: Conventional Lodging (hotels) and Vacation Rentals (Vrbo). This platform ensures that the booking is completed across all systems starting from the moment a traveler clicks "book" till the moment a supplier, a hotel property or a vacation rental host, actually confirms that room or home. It is the system of record and execution for every reservation created, retrieved, changed, cancelled, and reconciled across every EG brand and every point of sale, globally.
   

  

 The scale of these platforms is substantially high since Conventional Lodging alone represents a large majority of Expedia's transaction volume, processing bookings across local inventory, third\-party inventory, and GDS supply. Vacation Rentals adds a second, structurally distinct booking model, whole\-property rentals with owner/property\-manager supply, dynamic quote\-and\-hold flows, and its own settlement and payout mechanics. Across both businesses, this organization owns dozens of production services spanning booking orchestration, price/availability validation, fulfillment, cancellation, change management, settlement, and event publishing to finance and analytics.
   

  

 Platform capabilities you will own and continue to raise the bar on:
   

  

* Scalability — supporting booking, retrieve, and post\-booking traffic that scales across markets, brands, and business models without re\-architecting for every new use case.
* High\-performance — the team is actively driving end\-to\-end booking latency down, because every additional second at checkout measurably costs conversion and revenue.
* High throughput — the platform must absorb booking, price\-check, and inventory\-adjustment traffic at production scale continuously, including peak demand events, without degrading the traveler experience.
* Resiliency — this is a highly compliant and audited revenue\-critical system, designed with redundancy, safe rollout mechanisms, and recovery paths, because a failed booking is a failed sale.


**In This Role, You Will**
* Own the Conventional Lodging (hotels) and Vacation Rentals (Vrbo), defining and evolving a multi‑year technical and organizational strategy in partnership with Product, Architecture, and Operations.
* Shape a modular, API‑first, event‑driven architecture that supports rapid product innovation, new lines of business, and global scale.
* Lead the design and delivery of a workflow‑centric order orchestration layer using modern workflow engines and patterns (e.g., long‑running transactions, sagas, event sourcing) to ensure consistency and flexibility.
* Drive decomposition of legacy capabilities into well‑bounded domains and services with clear contracts, SLIs/SLOs, and guardrails, ensuring the platform is highly available, performant, observable, and cost‑efficient.
* Scale and lead a 50–60 person engineering organization through a team‑of‑teams model, setting clear outcomes and expectations, building hiring and succession plans, and fostering a culture of psychological safety, inclusion, high accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Drive engineering and operational excellence, raising the bar on design and code quality, testing, documentation, observability, release practices, and partnering with SRE/operations on robust incident management and learning loops.
* Define and track key platform and engineering metrics (e.g., availability, latency, throughput, correctness, unit cost, developer productivity) to guide priorities and trade‑offs.
* Lead through influence across Travel Foundations and Expedia Group, representing the OMS domain in cross‑functional forums, aligning roadmaps and dependencies, and communicating strategy, risks, and outcomes to senior leadership.
* Accelerate learning, modernization, and responsible AI/ML usage, championing modern development practices (CI/CD, trunk‑based development, automated testing, canary/blue‑green, feature flags) and safely integrating AI/ML‑enabled or rules‑based decisioning where it improves outcomes.
* Invest in talent development, creating clear growth paths and development plans for managers, tech leads, and ICs using Expedia Group’s refreshed technology role expectations.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* 12\+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating large‑scale, distributed systems, including multi‑service or multi‑domain platforms.
* 5\+ years of people leadership, including managing managers and leading organizations of 40\+ engineers (ideally 50–60\) across multiple teams.
* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience; a technical degree is preferred.
* Proven technical leadership in architecture and delivery for transactional/order management, e‑commerce, payments, or similar mission‑critical platforms at scale, with deep experience in service‑oriented and event‑driven architectures.
* Familiarity with AI‑driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real‑world products.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience designing or operating Conventional Lodging or core booking/fulfilment platforms in travel, e‑commerce, logistics, or payments.
* Hands‑on experience with modern workflow/orchestration engines and patterns for long‑running business processes.
* Background with cloud‑native platforms (e.g., container orchestration, service meshes, streaming platforms, managed databases) in a high‑scale environment.
* Experience leading globally distributed engineering teams and working across multiple time zones and cultures.
* Demonstrated success driving large‑scale modernization initiatives, such as domain‑driven decomposition of monoliths, platform consolidation, or migration to new architectures.
* Experience applying AI/ML or advanced analytics to improve platform reliability, efficiency, or decisioning in production systems.


**Accommodation requests**
 Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service\-now.com/askeg?id\=job\_accommodation.
   

  

**About Expedia Group**
 Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.
   

  

**Important notice**
 Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity**
 Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

------------------------------------------


* We value flexibility and support a healthy work\-life balance through remote and hybrid work options.

* A diverse and inclusive workplace that fosters innovation and collaboration.

title: AS400 Architect
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We are looking for a seasoned **AS/400 Architect** to define the technical vision and architectural direction for the AI Tools team, shaping EPAM's in\-house solution for IBM iSeries (AS/400\) application reverse engineering, analysis, and modernization at an enterprise scale.

**Responsibilities**

* Define the architectural vision, standards, and technical roadmap for the IBM iSeries (AS/400\) reverse\-engineering and modernization solution
* Conduct application portfolio analysis to identify redundant, unreachable, duplicated, obsolete, tightly coupled, and highly complex code, and assess application quality, maintainability, performance, technical debt, modernization readiness, and potential risks
* Analyze legacy IBM AS/400 applications, identify dependencies and business rules, trace data flows, document application behavior, and assess undocumented or complex codebases
* Drive IBM AS/400 modernization approaches, including code refactoring, format conversion, database modernization, API and web\-service enablement, UI modernization, application decomposition, cloud integration, re\-platforming, and application retirement
* Collaborate with the AI Tools team to define requirements, validate analysis logic, improve prompts and rules, and enhance the accuracy of AI\-generated application documentation and code insights
* Architect AI capabilities for program understanding, dependency discovery, business\-rule extraction, data\-flow analysis, impact analysis, code summarization, test\-case generation, and modernization recommendations
* Contribute to technical assessments, proofs of concept, solution demonstrations, effort estimation, project planning, risk identification, progress reporting, and executive\-level presentations
* Partner with customer IBM i SMEs, application owners, business analysts, modernization specialists, AI Tools team members, testing teams, cloud architects, and Technical Leadership across the client and EPAM organizations
* Ensure that the reverse\-engineering and modernization solution complies with enterprise architecture standards, customer security policies, source\-code handling requirements, data\-protection controls, audit requirements, and applicable regulatory obligations

**Requirements**

* 13\+ years of experience in enterprise midrange (iSeries or AS/400\) technologies, with 5\+ years focused on application analysis, reverse engineering, and modernization solutions
* Expertise in RPG III, RPG IV, and RPGLE, including hands\-on development, maintenance, and refactoring of large\-scale legacy applications
* Proficiency in free\-format RPG, CL/CLLE, and COBOL, with the ability to analyze and convert fixed\-format code to modern equivalents
* Skills in DDS, DSPFs, and SQL, including designing, interpreting, and optimizing display files, physical/logical files, and complex queries
* Background in Db2 for i, covering database design, performance tuning, journaling, stored procedures, triggers, and DDS\-to\-DDL conversion
* Understanding of IBM i architecture, including libraries, objects, service programs, printer files, commitment control, and integrated file systems
* Knowledge of reverse engineering techniques for legacy AS/400 applications, including dependency mapping, business\-rule extraction, and data\-flow tracing
* Familiarity with modernization strategies such as API enablement, web\-service integration, UI modernization, application decomposition, cloud migration, and re\-platforming
* Competency in application portfolio assessment, technical debt evaluation, code quality analysis, and modernization readiness reviews
* Capability to collaborate with AI Tools teams by defining requirements, validating analysis logic, refining prompts, and improving AI\-generated documentation and code insights
* Flexibility to support delivery activities, including proofs of concept, effort estimation, project planning, risk identification, and executive\-level presentations
* Showcase of strong stakeholder management skills to engage IBM i SMEs, application owners, business analysts, cloud architects, and technical leadership across client and internal organizations
* Qualifications in governance and compliance, ensuring adherence to enterprise architecture standards, security policies, data\-protection controls, and regulatory obligations
* Proficiency in English at an Upper\-Intermediate level (B2\) or higher

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

description:

This role will focus heavily on Workday platform engineering, integrations, APIs, automation, and Workday Extend development.

title: AWS Network Engineer
description:
Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose ‘
 **To Make Our Lives Easier** 
 .’ As the industry’s leading expert in embedded processing with unmatched quality and system\-level know\-how, we have evolved to provide scalable and comprehensive semiconductor solutions for automotive, industrial, infrastructure, and IoT industries based on the broadest product portfolio, including High Performance Computing, Embedded Processing, Analog \& Connectivity, and Power.
   

  

  

  

 With a diverse team of over 21,000 professionals in more than 30 countries, we continue to expand our boundaries to offer enhanced user experiences through digitalization and usher into a new era of innovation. We design and develop sustainable, power\-efficient solutions today that help people and communities thrive tomorrow, ‘
 **To Make Our Lives Easier** 
 .’
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 We are seeking an experienced AWS Cloud Networking Engineer to join our IT team and play an important role to design, build, operate secure, scalable, and highly available global AWS network infrastructure. The ideal candidate brings extensive hands\-on experience with AWS networking services, strong traditional networking fundamentals, and the ability to collaborate effectively with security, DevOps, developers, and engineering teams.
   

  





**Duties and responsibilities**



* Design, implement, and maintain AWS networking architectures, including VPCs, subnets, route tables, Transit Gateway, NAT Gateway, Internet Gateway, VPC endpoints, security groups, and network ACLs.
* Configure and support network services such as VPC peering, Transit Gateways, elastic load balancing, hybrid connectivity such as Direct Connect, and site\-to\-site VPN.
* Develop secure and scalable network infrastructure for multi\-account and multi\-region AWS environments, aligned with business, security, and operational requirements.
* Configure and support AWS WAF and third\-party firewalls.
* Collaborate with DevOps, security and development teams on network related issues.
* Automate cloud network provisioning and configuration using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or AWS CloudFormation.
* Monitor network performance, availability, and security using AWS CloudWatch, VPC Flow Logs, CloudTrail, SIEM platforms, and other monitoring or observability tools.
* Troubleshoot complex connectivity, routing, DNS, latency, packet loss, firewall, and performance issues; perform root cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Create and maintain accurate network documentation, diagrams, standards, runbooks, and standard operational procedures.
* Stay current with AWS networking services, cloud security practices, automation methods, and industry best practices, and recommend improvements where appropriate.


**Qualifications**

**Required Skills**



* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information technology or related field
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in designing, implementing and supporting AWS cloud networking solutions
* AWS Certified Advanced Networking \- Specialty is desirable
* Hands\-on experience with AWS networking services, including VPC, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, VPNs, Route 53, Elastic Load Balancing, route tables, VPC endpoints, security groups, and network ACLs.
* Strong knowledge of core networking concepts and protocols, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, subnetting, NAT, VPN, BGP, and OSPF.
* Deep understanding of network security concepts, including network segmentation, firewalls, WAF, access control, encryption in transit, traffic inspection, and secure hybrid connectivity.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation tools, preferably Terraform, with the ability to create reusable, maintainable, and version\-controlled network configurations.
* Experience with network monitoring, logging, and troubleshooting tools such as AWS CloudWatch, VPC Flow Logs, CloudTrail, or similar platforms.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to debug complex network issues in a timely manner.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to produce clear documentation, diagrams, and operational procedures.
* Strong ownership mindset, positive attitude, and ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.


**Additional Information**

 Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose,
 **To Make Our Lives Easier** 
 . With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.
   

  





 At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.
   

  





 We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.
   

  





 Are you ready to join our team and
 **shape the future** 
 with us?
   

  





 Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. For more information, please read our Diversity \& Inclusion Statement.

description:

Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next\-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start\-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!
   

  

 Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self\-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.
   

  

**Job Description**
 On a day\-to\-day basis, this individual will be responsible for administrating and implementing database solutions while providing system operational support, administration, problem resolution, and perform software installations and upgrades on our database systems concentrating on Google Cloud Platform and other cloud\-based solutions (up to 30%). The Database Administrator will be expected to exhibit strong troubleshooting techniques while striving to maintain a high level of customer satisfaction. Other duties also include monitoring performance and capacity on our database systems.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
 Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:
   

  

* Responsibility for all enterprise database technology deployed in the cloud including various versions of Microsoft SQL Server and other database platforms including features such as the core database engine, reporting, data loading and transformations, business intelligence, replication technologies and other modules. Perform configuration and maintenance of database platforms, including patching.
* Monitor database instances for performance, utilization, and capacity. Work with application teams when appropriate to address issues.
* Manage maintenance plans, backups, and automated jobs.
* Responsible for the database platform security model, including using Active Directory\-integrated accounts in a multi\-forest environment where appropriate.
* Responsible for query writing and optimization.

title: Security Engineer I, AWS Security Incident Response
description:
**Description**
 AWS Security Incident Response is looking for technical Security Engineers that are passionate about learning new concepts and work well within a team environment to keep customers secure. We value engineers that can work through ambiguity to identify suspicious activity, lead security response, and can explain technical security concepts to non\-technical audiences.
   

  

 AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
   

  

 AWS Services provides developers and small to large businesses access to the horizontally scalable state of the art cloud infrastructure like S3, EC2, AMI, Cloud Front and Simple DB, that powers Amazon.com. Developers can build any type of business on AWS Platform and scale their application with growing business needs. We want you to help share and shape our mission to be Earth's most customer\-centric company. Our evolution from Web site to e\-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of invention that is part of our DNA. We do every day by inventing elegant and simple solutions to complex technical and business problems. We're making history and the good news is that we've only just begun.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Respond to threat findings that indicate unauthorized activity has occurred
* Identify, evaluate and communicate security threats, risks and vulnerabilities, and propose recommended remediation for security issues.
* Contribute to the development of security automation and security posture improvements.
* Track and report on the effectiveness of AWS detective controls such as Amazon GuardDuty and partner products such as CrowdStrike Falcon or Wiz Defend
* Develop processes and policies to increase security response effectiveness.
* On\-call support: This role requires periodic on\-call responsibilities including weekends.


 A day in the life
   

  

 As a Security Engineer in AWS Security Incident Response, your responsibilities include monitoring networks and systems for potential threats, performing triage for security alerts, documenting suspicious activity, and reporting issues so they can be adequately handled. You will work alongside our security engineers and partner teams to perform daily threat detection and incident response, using the full capability of AWS technologies and services to detect and mitigate cyber threats at a massive scale and help protect AWS Customers. You should also enjoy learning about the most up\-to\-date new technologies and procedures to protect information systems and data.
   

  

**About The Team**
 AWS Security Incident Response provides 24/7 threat monitoring, investigation, and response across for customer’s AWS environments. The service enhances existing security capabilities by providing security monitoring for all native AWS services and supports vendor agnostic detective and protective controls to provide holistic security controls for customers. This is done by leveraging data on common attack techniques to enhance detective controls and incident response, then building auto\-remediation capabilities to minimize disruption to customer workloads. When a security event does happen, you will be there provide guidance.
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience with web protocols, common security attacks, and remediation (non\-internship)
* Experience scripting in modern programming languages, or experience troubleshooting and documenting findings
* Knowledge of operating systems, hardware, storage, network, security, database administration and cloud infrastructure


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience triaging security risks or vulnerabilities and ensuring that they are properly understood by the business and fixed or mitigated
* GCIH (GIAC Certified Incident Handler) or GSEC (GIAC Security Essentials) or Security\+, or Associate's degree

If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
